text: Through the wrath of Jehovah of hosts is the land burned up, and the people is as fuel for fire: a man spareth not his brother;

title: Isaiah 9:20
text: and he snatcheth on the right hand, and is hungry, and eateth on the left hand; and they are not satisfied. They eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

title: Isaiah 9:21
text: Manasseh, Ephraim, and Ephraim, Manasseh; [and] they together are against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 10:1
text: ¶Woe unto them that decree iniquitous decrees, and to the writers that prescribe oppression,

title: Isaiah 10:2
text: to turn away the poor from judgment, and to take away the right from the afflicted of my people; that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

title: Isaiah 10:3
text: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the sudden destruction [which] shall come from far? To whom will ye flee for help, and where will ye leave your glory?

title: Isaiah 10:4
text: They can but crouch under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 10:5
text: ¶Ah! the Assyrian! the rod of mine anger! and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.

title: Isaiah 10:6
text: I will send him against a hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge; to take the spoil, and to seize the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

title: Isaiah 10:7
text: But he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; for it is in his heart to extirpate and cut off nations not a few.

title: Isaiah 10:8
text: For he saith, Are not my princes all kings?

title: Isaiah 10:9
text: Is not Calno as Karkemish? Is not Hamath as Arpad? Is not Samaria as Damascus?

title: Isaiah 10:10
text: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, --and their graven images exceeded those of Jerusalem and Samaria,

title: Isaiah 10:11
text: --shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her images?

title: Isaiah 10:12
text: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and upon Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stoutness of heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

title: Isaiah 10:13
text: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done [it], and by my wisdom, for I am intelligent; and I have removed the bounds of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures, and, like a valiant man, I have brought down them that sit [on thrones];

title: Isaiah 10:14
text: and my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the peoples, and as one gathereth forsaken eggs, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or chirped.

title: Isaiah 10:15
text: --Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? shall the saw magnify itself against him that wieldeth it? As if the rod should wield them that lift it up; as if the staff should lift up [him who is] not wood!

title: Isaiah 10:16
text: Therefore shall the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness, and under his glory he shall kindle a burning, like the burning of a fire:

title: Isaiah 10:17
text: and the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briars in one day,

title: Isaiah 10:18
text: and it shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body; and they shall be as when a sick man fainteth.

title: Isaiah 10:19
text: And the remainder of the trees of his forest shall be few: yea, a child might write them.

title: Isaiah 10:20
text: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the remnant of Israel and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob shall no more again rely upon him that smote them; but they shall rely upon Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

title: Isaiah 10:21
text: The remnant shall return, the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty *God.

title: Isaiah 10:22
text: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, [only] a remnant of them shall return: the consumption determined shall overflow in righteousness.

title: Isaiah 10:23
text: For a consumption, and [one] determined, will the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, accomplish in the midst of all the land.

title: Isaiah 10:24
text: ¶Therefore thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts: O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian; he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt:

title: Isaiah 10:25
text: for yet a very little while, and the indignation shall be accomplished, and mine anger, in their destruction.

title: Isaiah 10:26
text: And Jehovah of hosts will stir up a scourge against him, according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and his rod [shall be] upon the sea, and he will lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 10:27
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck; and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing. ...

title: Isaiah 10:28
text: He is come to Aiath, he hath passed through Migron; at Michmash he layeth up his baggage.

title: Isaiah 10:29
text: They are gone through the pass; they make their lodging at Geba: Ramah trembleth, Gibeah of Saul is fled.

title: Isaiah 10:30
text: Lift up thy voice, daughter of Gallim! Hearken, O Laish! --Poor Anathoth!

title: Isaiah 10:31
text: Madmenah is fugitive; the inhabitants of Gebim take to flight.

title: Isaiah 10:32
text: Still a day of halting at Nob; he shaketh his hand [against] the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem. ...

title: Isaiah 10:33
text: Behold the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, shall lop the boughs with violence; and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be brought low;

title: Isaiah 10:34
text: and he shall make clearings in the thickets of the forest with iron; and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

title: Isaiah 11:1
text: ¶And there shall come forth a shoot out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots shall be fruitful;

title: Isaiah 11:2
text: and the Spirit of Jehovah shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 11:3
text: And his delight will be in the fear of Jehovah; and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears;

title: Isaiah 11:4
text: but with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

title: Isaiah 11:5
text: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his reins, and faithfulness the girdle of his loins.

title: Isaiah 11:6
text: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid, and the calf and the young lion and the fatted beast together, and a little child shall lead them.

title: Isaiah 11:7
text: And the cow and the she-bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

title: Isaiah 11:8
text: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the adder, and the weaned child shall put forth its hand to the viper's den.

title: Isaiah 11:9
text: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Jehovah, as the waters cover the sea.

title: Isaiah 11:10
text: ¶And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, standing as a banner of the peoples: the nations shall seek it; and his resting-place shall be glory.

title: Isaiah 11:11
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to acquire the remnant of his people which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

title: Isaiah 11:12
text: And he shall lift up a banner to the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

title: Isaiah 11:13
text: And the envy of Ephraim shall depart, and the troublers of Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim will not envy Judah, and Judah will not trouble Ephraim:

title: Isaiah 11:14
text: but they shall fly upon the shoulder of the Philistines towards the west; together shall they spoil the sons of the east; they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

title: Isaiah 11:15
text: And Jehovah will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind will he shake his hand over the river, and will smite it into seven streams, and make [men] go over dryshod.

title: Isaiah 11:16
text: And there shall be a highway for the remnant of his people which will be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day when he went up out of the land of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 12:1
text: ¶And in that day thou shalt say, Jehovah, I will praise thee; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.

title: Isaiah 12:2
text: Behold, *God is my salvation: I will trust, and not be afraid; for Jah, Jehovah, is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation.

title: Isaiah 12:3
text: And with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

title: Isaiah 12:4
text: ¶And in that day shall ye say, Give ye thanks to Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his deeds among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.

title: Isaiah 12:5
text: Sing psalms of Jehovah, for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

title: Isaiah 12:6
text: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitress of Zion; for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

title: Isaiah 13:1
text: ¶The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

title: Isaiah 13:2
text: Lift up a banner upon a bare mountain, raise the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.

title: Isaiah 13:3
text: I have commanded my hallowed ones, I have also called my mighty men for mine anger, them that rejoice in my highness.

title: Isaiah 13:4
text: The noise of a multitude on the mountains, as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations assembled together: Jehovah of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

title: Isaiah 13:5
text: They come from a far country, from the end of the heavens--Jehovah, and the weapons of his indignation--to destroy the whole land.

title: Isaiah 13:6
text: ¶Howl, for the day of Jehovah is at hand; it cometh as destruction from the Almighty.

title: Isaiah 13:7
text: Therefore shall all hands be feeble, and every heart of man shall melt,

title: Isaiah 13:8
text: and they shall be terrified: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them, they shall writhe as a woman that travaileth; they shall be amazed one at another, their faces shall be as flames.

title: Isaiah 13:9
text: Behold, the day of Jehovah cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the earth desolate; and he will destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

title: Isaiah 13:10
text: For the stars of the heavens and the constellations thereof shall not give their light; the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

title: Isaiah 13:11
text: And I will punish the world for evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will make the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will bring low the haughtiness of the violent.

title: Isaiah 13:12
text: I will make a man more precious than fine gold, even man than the gold of Ophir.

title: Isaiah 13:13
text: Therefore I will make the heavens to shake, and the earth shall be removed out of her place, at the wrath of Jehovah of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

title: Isaiah 13:14
text: And it shall be as with a chased roe, and as with a flock that no man gathereth together; every one shall turn to his own people, and every one flee into his own land.

title: Isaiah 13:15
text: All that are found shall be thrust through; and every one that is in league [with them] shall fall by the sword.

title: Isaiah 13:16
text: And their infants shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes, their houses shall be rifled, and their women ravished.

title: Isaiah 13:17
text: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who do not regard silver, and as for gold, they have no delight in it.

title: Isaiah 13:18
text: And [their] bows shall dash the young men to pieces, and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb: their eye shall not spare children.

title: Isaiah 13:19
text: ¶And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans' pride, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

title: Isaiah 13:20
text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in, even to generation and generation; nor shall Arabian pitch tent there, nor shepherds make fold there.

title: Isaiah 13:21
text: But beasts of the desert shall lie there, and their houses shall be full of owls; and ostriches shall dwell there, and wild goats shall dance there.

title: Isaiah 13:22
text: And jackals shall cry to one another in their palaces, and wild dogs in the pleasant castles. And her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

title: Isaiah 14:1
text: ¶For Jehovah will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in rest in their own land; and the stranger shall be united to them, and they shall be joined to the house of Jacob.

title: Isaiah 14:2
text: And the peoples shall take them and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah for servants and handmaids; and they shall take them captive whose captives they were, and they shall rule over their oppressors.

title: Isaiah 14:3
text: And it shall come to pass in the day that Jehovah shall give thee rest from thy sorrow and from thy trouble and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

title: Isaiah 14:4
text: ¶that thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased, --the exactress of gold ceased!

title: Isaiah 14:5
text: Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers.

title: Isaiah 14:6
text: He that smote the peoples in wrath with a relentless stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted unsparingly.

title: Isaiah 14:7
text: The whole earth is at rest, is quiet: they break forth into singing.

title: Isaiah 14:8
text: Even the cypresses rejoice at thee, the cedars of Lebanon, [saying,] Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

title: Isaiah 14:9
text: Sheol from beneath is moved for thee to meet [thee] at thy coming, stirring up the dead for thee, all the he-goats of the earth; making to rise from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

title: Isaiah 14:10
text: All of them shall answer and say unto thee, Art thou also become powerless as we; art thou become like unto us!

title: Isaiah 14:11
text: --Thy pomp is brought down to Sheol, the noise of thy lyres: the maggot is spread under thee, and worms cover thee.

title: Isaiah 14:12
text: How art thou fallen from heaven, Lucifer, son of the morning! Thou art cut down to the ground, that didst prostrate the nations!

title: Isaiah 14:13
text: And thou that didst say in thy heart, I will ascend into the heavens, I will exalt my throne above the stars of *God, and I will sit upon the mount of assembly, in the recesses of the north;

title: Isaiah 14:14
text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds, I will be like the Most High:

title: Isaiah 14:15
text: none the less art thou brought down to Sheol, to the recesses of the pit.

title: Isaiah 14:16
text: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee; they shall consider thee, [saying,] Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that shook kingdoms;

title: Isaiah 14:17
text: [that] made the world as a wilderness, and overthrew the cities thereof; [that] dismissed not his prisoners homewards?

title: Isaiah 14:18
text: --All the kings of the nations, all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house;

title: Isaiah 14:19
text: but thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, covered with the slain--those thrust through with the sword, that go down to the stones of the pit: like a carcase trodden under foot.

title: Isaiah 14:20
text: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial; for thou hast destroyed thy land, hast slain thy people. Of the seed of evildoers no mention shall be made for ever.

title: Isaiah 14:21
text: Prepare ye slaughter for his children, because of the iniquity of their fathers; that they may not rise up and possess the earth, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

title: Isaiah 14:22
text: For I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and scion and descendant, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 14:23
text: And I will make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water; and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 14:24
text: ¶Jehovah of hosts hath sworn saying, Assuredly as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, it shall stand:

title: Isaiah 14:25
text: to break the Assyrian in my land; and upon my mountains will I tread him under foot; and his yoke shall depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

title: Isaiah 14:26
text: This is the counsel which is purposed concerning the whole earth; and this is the hand which is stretched out upon all the nations.

title: Isaiah 14:27
text: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall frustrate [it]? And his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

title: Isaiah 14:28
text: In the year of the death of king Ahaz was this burden:

title: Isaiah 14:29
text: Rejoice not thou, Philistia, all of thee, because the rod that smote thee is broken; for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a viper, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

title: Isaiah 14:30
text: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; but I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain.

title: Isaiah 14:31
text: Howl, O gate! cry, O city! thou, Philistia, art wholly dissolved; for there cometh from the north a smoke, and none remaineth apart in his gatherings [of troops].

title: Isaiah 14:32
text: And what shall be answered to the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah hath founded Zion, and the afflicted of his people find refuge in it.

title: Isaiah 15:1
text: ¶The burden of Moab: For in the night of being laid waste, Ar of Moab is destroyed; for in the night of being laid waste, Kir of Moab is destroyed!

title: Isaiah 15:2
text: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep; Moab howleth over Nebo, and over Medeba; on all their heads is baldness, every beard is cut off.

title: Isaiah 15:3
text: In their streets they are girded with sackcloth; on their roofs, and in their broadways, every one howleth, melted into tears.

title: Isaiah 15:4
text: And Heshbon crieth, and Elealeh: their voice is heard unto Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out: his soul trembleth in him.

title: Isaiah 15:5
text: My heart crieth out for Moab; their fugitives [have fled] unto Zoar, unto Eglath-Sheli-shijah: for by the ascent of Luhith, with weeping they go up by it; for in the way of Horonaim they raise up a cry of destruction.

title: Isaiah 15:6
text: ¶For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate; for the herbage is withered away, the grass hath failed, there is no green thing.

title: Isaiah 15:7
text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, do they carry away to the torrent of the willows.

title: Isaiah 15:8
text: For the cry goeth round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.

title: Isaiah 15:9
text: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood, for I will lay yet more upon Dimon: a lion upon them that are escaped of Moab, and upon that which remaineth of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:1
text: ¶Send the lamb of the ruler of the land from the rock to the wilderness, --unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

title: Isaiah 16:2
text: And it shall be [that] as a wandering bird, [as] a scattered nest, so shall the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

title: Isaiah 16:3
text: Bring in counsel, execute justice; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of noonday; hide the outcasts, discover not the fugitive.

title: Isaiah 16:4
text: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the waster. For the extortioner is at an end, the wasting hath ceased, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:5
text: And a throne shall be established in mercy: and in the tent of David there shall sit upon it, in truth, one judging and seeking justice and hastening righteousness.

title: Isaiah 16:6
text: ¶We have heard of the arrogance of Moab, --[he is] very proud, --of his pride, and his arrogance, and his wrath: his pratings are vain.

title: Isaiah 16:7
text: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab; every one of them shall howl. For the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn, verily afflicted.

title: Isaiah 16:8
text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, the vine of Sibmah; the lords of the nations have broken down its choice plants: they reached unto Jaazer, they wandered [through] the wilderness; its shoots stretched out, they went beyond the sea.

title: Isaiah 16:9
text: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jaazer for the vine of Sibmah; with my tears will I water thee, Heshbon, and Elealeh, for a cry is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy harvest.

title: Isaiah 16:10
text: And joy and gladness is taken away out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there is no singing, neither is there shouting: the treaders tread out no wine in the presses, I have made the cry [of the winepress] to cease.

title: Isaiah 16:11
text: Therefore my bowels sound like a harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirheres.

title: Isaiah 16:12
text: And it shall come to pass, when Moab shall appear, shall weary himself on the high place, and enter into his sanctuary to pray, that he shall not prevail.

title: Isaiah 16:13
text: This is the word which Jehovah hath spoken from of old concerning Moab.

title: Isaiah 16:14
text: And now Jehovah speaketh saying, Within three years, as the years of a hired servant, and the glory of Moab shall be brought to nothing, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be small, few, of no account.

title: Isaiah 17:1
text: ¶The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from [being] a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

title: Isaiah 17:2
text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks; and they shall lie down and there shall be none to make them afraid.

title: Isaiah 17:3
text: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 17:4
text: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall become lean.

title: Isaiah 17:5
text: And it shall be as when the reaper gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; yea, it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

title: Isaiah 17:6
text: ¶And a gleaning shall be left in it, as at the shaking of an olive-tree: two, three berries above, in the tree-top; four, five in its fruitful boughs, saith Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:7
text: In that day shall man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have regard to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:8
text: And he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, nor have regard to what his fingers have made, neither the Asherahs nor the sun-images.

title: Isaiah 17:9
text: ¶In that day shall his strong cities be as the forsaken tract in the woodland, and the mountain-top which they forsook before the children of Israel; and there shall be desolation.

title: Isaiah 17:10
text: For thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength; therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plantations, and shalt set them with foreign slips:

title: Isaiah 17:11
text: in the day of thy planting wilt thou make [them] to grow, and on the morrow wilt thou make thy seed to flourish; [but] the harvest will flee in the day of taking possession, and the sorrow will be incurable.

title: Isaiah 17:12
text: ¶Ha! a tumult of many peoples! they make a noise as the noise of the seas; --and the rushing of nations! they rush as the rushing of mighty waters.

title: Isaiah 17:13
text: The nations rush as the rushing of many waters; but he will rebuke them, and they shall flee far away, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a whirling [of dust] before the whirlwind:

title: Isaiah 17:14
text: behold, at eventide, trouble; before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

title: Isaiah 18:1
text: ¶Ha! land shadowing with wings, which art beyond the rivers of Cush,

title: Isaiah 18:2
text: that sendest ambassadors over the sea, and in vessels of papyrus upon the waters, [saying,] Go, swift messengers, to a nation scattered and ravaged, to a people terrible from their existence and thenceforth; to a nation of continued waiting and of treading down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

title: Isaiah 18:3
text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, see ye, and when a trumpet is blown, hear ye!

title: Isaiah 18:4
text: For thus hath Jehovah said unto me: I will take my rest, and I will observe from my dwelling-place like clear heat upon herbs, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

title: Isaiah 18:5
text: For before the harvest, when the blossoming is over, and the flower becometh a ripening grape, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning-knives, and take away [and] cut down the branches.

title: Isaiah 18:6
text: They shall be left together unto the mountain birds of prey, and to the beasts of the earth; and the birds of prey shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

title: Isaiah 18:7
text: In that time shall a present be brought unto Jehovah of hosts of a people scattered and ravaged, --and from a people terrible from their existence and thenceforth, a nation of continued waiting and of treading down, whose land the rivers have spoiled, ...to the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 19:1
text: ¶The burden of Egypt. Behold, Jehovah rideth upon a swift cloud, and cometh to Egypt; and the idols of Egypt are moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt melteth in the midst of it.

title: Isaiah 19:2
text: And I will incite the Egyptians against the Egyptians; and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

title: Isaiah 19:3
text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst of it, and I will destroy the counsel thereof; and they shall seek unto the idols and unto the conjurers, and unto the necromancers, and unto the soothsayers.

title: Isaiah 19:4
text: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord, and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 19:5
text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up;

title: Isaiah 19:6
text: and the rivers shall stink, and the streams of Egypt shall be diminished and drain away: the reeds and sedges shall wither.

title: Isaiah 19:7
text: The meadows by the Nile, on the banks of the Nile, and everything sown by the Nile, shall be dried up, be driven away, and be no [more].

title: Isaiah 19:8
text: And the fishers shall mourn, and all they that cast fish-hook into the Nile shall lament, and they that spread net upon the waters shall languish.

title: Isaiah 19:9
text: And they that work in fine flax, and they that weave white stuffs shall be ashamed.

title: Isaiah 19:10
text: And her pillars shall be broken in pieces, and all workers for hire shall be sad of soul.

title: Isaiah 19:11
text: They are but fools, the princes of Zoan, the wise counsellors of Pharaoh: [their] counsel is become senseless. How say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

title: Isaiah 19:12
text: Where are they then, thy wise [men]? Let them now tell thee, and let them make known what Jehovah of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

title: Isaiah 19:13
text: The princes of Zoan are become foolish, the princes of Noph are deceived; and the corner-stones of its tribes have caused Egypt to err.

title: Isaiah 19:14
text: Jehovah hath mingled a spirit of perverseness in the midst thereof; and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunkard staggereth in his vomit.

title: Isaiah 19:15
text: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, palm-branch or rush, may do.

title: Isaiah 19:16
text: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women; and it shall tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Jehovah of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

title: Isaiah 19:17
text: And the land of Judah shall be a dismay unto Egypt: every one that thinketh of it shall be afraid for himself, because of the counsel of Jehovah of hosts, which he hath purposed against it.

title: Isaiah 19:18
text: ¶In that day shall there be five cities in the land of Egypt speaking the language of Canaan, and swearing by Jehovah of hosts: one shall be called, The city of Heres.

title: Isaiah 19:19
text: In that day shall there be an altar to Jehovah in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Jehovah:

title: Isaiah 19:20
text: and it shall be for a sign and for a witness to Jehovah of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they shall cry unto Jehovah because of the oppressors, and he will send them a saviour and defender, who shall deliver them.

title: Isaiah 19:21
text: And Jehovah shall be known to the Egyptians, and the Egyptians shall know Jehovah in that day, and shall serve with sacrifice and oblation; and they shall vow a vow unto Jehovah, and perform it.

title: Isaiah 19:22
text: And Jehovah will smite Egypt; he will smite and heal: and they shall return to Jehovah, and he will be entreated of them, and will heal them.

title: Isaiah 19:23
text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria; and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and Egypt shall serve with Assyria.

title: Isaiah 19:24
text: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

title: Isaiah 19:25
text: whom Jehovah of hosts will bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance!

title: Isaiah 20:1
text: ¶In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, (and he fought against Ashdod and took it,)

title: Isaiah 20:2
text: at that time spoke Jehovah by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy sandal from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

title: Isaiah 20:3
text: And Jehovah said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years, a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

title: Isaiah 20:4
text: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, [to] the shame of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 20:5
text: And they shall be terrified and ashamed of Ethiopia their confidence, and of Egypt their boast.

title: Isaiah 20:6
text: And the inhabitants of this coast shall say in that day, Behold, such is our confidence, whither we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria; and how shall we escape?

title: Isaiah 21:1
text: ¶The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through, so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.

title: Isaiah 21:2
text: A grievous vision is declared unto me: the treacherous dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, Elam! besiege, Media! All the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

title: Isaiah 21:3
text: Therefore are my loins filled with pain; anguish hath taken hold upon me, as the anguish of a woman in travail: I am bowed down so as not to hear, I am dismayed so as not to see.

title: Isaiah 21:4
text: My heart panteth, horror affrighteth me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into trembling unto me.

title: Isaiah 21:5
text: Prepare the table, appoint the watch; eat, drink: arise, ye princes, anoint the shield.

title: Isaiah 21:6
text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me: Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.

title: Isaiah 21:7
text: And he saw chariots, horsemen by pairs, a chariot with asses, a chariot with camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed.

title: Isaiah 21:8
text: And he cried [as] a lion, Lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights.

title: Isaiah 21:9
text: --And behold, there cometh a chariot of men; horsemen by pairs. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.

title: Isaiah 21:10
text: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor! What I have heard of Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

title: Isaiah 21:11
text: ¶The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

title: Isaiah 21:12
text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire; return, come.

title: Isaiah 21:13
text: ¶The burden against Arabia. In the forest of Arabia shall ye lodge, [ye] caravans of Dedanites.

title: Isaiah 21:14
text: Bring ye water to meet the thirsty! The inhabitants of the land of Tema come forth with their bread for him that fleeth.

title: Isaiah 21:15
text: For they flee from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

title: Isaiah 21:16
text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me: Within a year, according to the years of a hired servant, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail;

title: Isaiah 21:17
text: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the sons of Kedar, shall be diminished: for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath spoken.

title: Isaiah 22:1
text: ¶The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

title: Isaiah 22:2
text: Thou that wast full of stir, a town of tumult, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

title: Isaiah 22:3
text: All thy rulers have fled together, they are taken prisoners without the bow: all that are found of thee are made prisoners together; they were fleeing far off.

title: Isaiah 22:4
text: Therefore said I, Look away from me; let me weep bitterly: labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

title: Isaiah 22:5
text: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, in the valley of vision; [a day of] breaking down the wall, and of crying to the mountain:

title: Isaiah 22:6
text: --Elam beareth the quiver with chariots of men [and] horsemen; and Kir uncovereth the shield.

title: Isaiah 22:7
text: And it shall come to pass [that] thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

title: Isaiah 22:8
text: ¶And he uncovereth the covering of Judah: and thou didst look in that day to the armour in the house of the forest;

title: Isaiah 22:9
text: and ye have seen the breaches of the city of David, that they are many; and ye have gathered together the waters of the lower pool;

title: Isaiah 22:10
text: and ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and have broken down the houses to fortify the wall;

title: Isaiah 22:11
text: and ye have made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not had regard unto the maker thereof, neither have ye looked unto him that fashioned it long ago.

title: Isaiah 22:12
text: And in that day did the Lord Jehovah of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth;

title: Isaiah 22:13
text: and behold joy and rejoicing, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: --Let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we die.

title: Isaiah 22:14
text: And it was revealed in mine ears by Jehovah of hosts: Assuredly this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Isaiah 22:15
text: ¶Thus saith the Lord Jehovah of hosts: Go, get thee in unto this steward, unto Shebna, who is over the house, [and say,]

title: Isaiah 22:16
text: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewn thee out a sepulchre here, [as] he that heweth out his sepulchre on high, cutting out in the rock a habitation for himself?

title: Isaiah 22:17
text: Behold, Jehovah will hurl thee with the force of a mighty man, and will cover thee entirely.

title: Isaiah 22:18
text: Rolling thee up completely, he will roll thee as a ball into a wide country: there shalt thou die, and there shall be the chariots of thy glory, O shame of thy lord's house!

title: Isaiah 22:19
text: And I will drive thee from thine office, and from thy station will I pull thee down.

title: Isaiah 22:20
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkijah;

title: Isaiah 22:21
text: and I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand; and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

title: Isaiah 22:22
text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

title: Isaiah 22:23
text: And I will fasten him [as] a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a throne of glory to his father's house:

title: Isaiah 22:24
text: and they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all the small vessels, as well the vessels of cups as all the vessels of flagons.

title: Isaiah 22:25
text: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in a sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Isaiah 23:1
text: ¶The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish! for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, none entering in. From the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

title: Isaiah 23:2
text: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle! The merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished thee.

title: Isaiah 23:3
text: And on great waters, the seed of Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she was the market of the nations.

title: Isaiah 23:4
text: Be thou ashamed, Sidon, for the sea hath spoken, the strength of the sea, saying, I have not travailed nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men [nor] brought up virgins.

title: Isaiah 23:5
text: --When the report came into Egypt, they were sorely pained at the news of Tyre.

title: Isaiah 23:6
text: Pass over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the coast!

title: Isaiah 23:7
text: Is this your joyous [city], whose antiquity is of ancient days? Her feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

title: Isaiah 23:8
text: Who hath purposed this against Tyre, the distributor of crowns, whose merchants were princes, whose dealers were the honourable of the earth?

title: Isaiah 23:9
text: Jehovah of hosts hath purposed it, to profane the pride of all glory, to bring to nought all the honourable of the earth.

title: Isaiah 23:10
text: Overflow thy land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish: there is no more restraint.

title: Isaiah 23:11
text: He hath stretched out his hand over the sea, he shaketh the kingdoms. Jehovah hath given a commandment concerning Canaan, to destroy the strongholds thereof,

title: Isaiah 23:12
text: and hath said, Thou shalt no more exult, [thou] oppressed virgin, daughter of Sidon: get thee up, pass over to Chittim; even there shalt thou have no rest.

title: Isaiah 23:13
text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans: this people did not exist; the Assyrian founded it for the dwellers in the desert: they set up their towers, they destroyed the palaces thereof; he brought it to ruin.

title: Isaiah 23:14
text: Howl, ships of Tarshish! for your fortress is laid waste.

title: Isaiah 23:15
text: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it shall be for Tyre as the harlot's song.

title: Isaiah 23:16
text: Take a harp, go about the city, thou forgotten harlot! Make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

title: Isaiah 23:17
text: And it shall come to pass at the end of seventy years, that Jehovah will visit Tyre; and she will return to her hire, and will commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the earth upon the face of the ground.

title: Isaiah 23:18
text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holy to Jehovah: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Jehovah, to eat and be sufficed, and for excellent clothing.

title: Isaiah 24:1
text: ¶Behold, Jehovah maketh the land empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad its inhabitants.

title: Isaiah 24:2
text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with him from whom usury is taken.

title: Isaiah 24:3
text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled; for Jehovah hath spoken this word.

title: Isaiah 24:4
text: The land mourneth, it fadeth away; the world languisheth, it fadeth away: the haughty people of the land do languish.

title: Isaiah 24:5
text: And the land is polluted under the inhabitants thereof; for they have violated the laws, changed the statute, broken the everlasting covenant.

title: Isaiah 24:6
text: Therefore doth the curse devour the earth, and they that dwell therein are held guilty; therefore the inhabitants of the earth are consumed, and few men are left.

title: Isaiah 24:7
text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all that were merry-hearted do sigh;

title: Isaiah 24:8
text: the mirth of tambours ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

title: Isaiah 24:9
text: They do not drink wine with a song; strong drink is bitter to them that drink it.

title: Isaiah 24:10
text: The city of solitude is broken down; every house is shut up, so that none entereth in.

title: Isaiah 24:11
text: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone;

title: Isaiah 24:12
text: desolation remaineth in the city, and the gate is smitten, --a ruin.

title: Isaiah 24:13
text: ¶For so will it be in the midst of the land among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive-tree, as the grape-gleanings when the vintage is done.

title: Isaiah 24:14
text: These shall lift up their voice, they shall shout for the majesty of Jehovah, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

title: Isaiah 24:15
text: Therefore glorify Jehovah in the east, the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the isles of the west.

title: Isaiah 24:16
text: ¶From the end of the earth have we heard songs: Glory to the righteous! And I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! The treacherous have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

title: Isaiah 24:17
text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare are upon thee, inhabitant of the land.

title: Isaiah 24:18
text: And it shall come to pass, [that] he who fleeth from the sound of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are open, and the foundations of the earth shake.

title: Isaiah 24:19
text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is completely dissolved, the earth is violently moved.

title: Isaiah 24:20
text: The earth reeleth to and fro like a drunkard, and is shaken like a night hut; and its transgression is heavy upon it; and it falleth and shall not rise again.

title: Isaiah 24:21
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] Jehovah will punish the host of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

title: Isaiah 24:22
text: And they shall be brought together, [as] an assemblage of prisoners for the pit, and shall be shut up in prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

title: Isaiah 24:23
text: And the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Jehovah of hosts shall reign on mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients in glory.

title: Isaiah 25:1
text: ¶Jehovah, thou art my God: I will exalt thee; I will celebrate thy name, for thou hast done wonderful things; counsels of old [which are] faithfulness [and] truth.

title: Isaiah 25:2
text: For thou hast made of the city a heap, of the fortified town a ruin, the palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built up.

title: Isaiah 25:3
text: Therefore shall the mighty people glorify thee, the city of terrible nations shall fear thee.

title: Isaiah 25:4
text: For thou hast been a fortress to the poor, a fortress for the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat: for the blast of the terrible ones [has been] as the storm [against] a wall.

title: Isaiah 25:5
text: Thou hast subdued the tumult of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; [as] the heat, by the shadow of a cloud, [so] the song of the terrible ones is brought low.

title: Isaiah 25:6
text: ¶And in this mountain will Jehovah of hosts make unto all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

title: Isaiah 25:7
text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the veil which veileth all the peoples, and the covering that is spread over all the nations.

title: Isaiah 25:8
text: He will swallow up death in victory. And the Lord Jehovah will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the reproach of his people will he take away from off all the earth: for Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Isaiah 25:9
text: ¶And it shall be said in that day, Behold, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is Jehovah, we have waited for him; we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

title: Isaiah 25:10
text: For in this mountain shall the hand of Jehovah rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, as straw is trodden down in the dunghill;

title: Isaiah 25:11
text: and he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth them forth to swim; and he shall bring down their pride together with the plots of their hands.

title: Isaiah 25:12
text: And the fortress of the high defences of thy walls will he bring down, lay low, bring to the ground, into the dust.

title: Isaiah 26:1
text: ¶In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation doth he appoint for walls and bulwarks.

title: Isaiah 26:2
text: Open ye the gates, and the righteous nation which keepeth faithfulness shall enter in.

title: Isaiah 26:3
text: Thou wilt keep in perfect peace the mind stayed [on thee], for he confideth in thee.

title: Isaiah 26:4
text: Confide ye in Jehovah for ever; for in Jah, Jehovah, is the rock of ages.

title: Isaiah 26:5
text: ¶For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low, he layeth it low to the ground, he bringeth it even to the dust.

title: Isaiah 26:6
text: The foot shall tread it down, --the feet of the afflicted, the steps of the poor.

title: Isaiah 26:7
text: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, the Upright, dost make the path of the just even.

title: Isaiah 26:8
text: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Jehovah, have we waited for thee; the desire of [our] soul is to thy name, and to thy memorial.

title: Isaiah 26:9
text: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

title: Isaiah 26:10
text: If favour be shewn to the wicked, he doth not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness he dealeth unjustly, and beholdeth not the majesty of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 26:11
text: Jehovah, thy hand is lifted up, but they do not see: [yet] they shall see [thy] jealousy [for] the people, and be ashamed; yea, the fire which is for thine adversaries shall devour them.

title: Isaiah 26:12
text: ¶Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou also hast wrought all our works for us.

title: Isaiah 26:13
text: Jehovah our God, other lords than thee have had dominion over us; by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

title: Isaiah 26:14
text: [They are] dead, they shall not live; deceased, they shall not rise: for thou hast visited and destroyed them, and made all memory of them to perish.

title: Isaiah 26:15
text: Thou hast increased the nation, Jehovah, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified. Thou hadst removed [it] far [unto] all the ends of the earth.

title: Isaiah 26:16
text: Jehovah, in trouble they sought thee; they poured out [their] whispered prayer when thy chastening was upon them.

title: Isaiah 26:17
text: As a woman with child, that draweth near her delivery, is in travail, [and] crieth out in her pangs; so have we been before thee, Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 26:18
text: We have been with child, we have been in travail, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought the deliverance of the land, neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

title: Isaiah 26:19
text: Thy dead shall live, my dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing in triumph, ye that dwell in dust; for thy dew is the dew of the morning, and the earth shall cast forth the dead.

title: Isaiah 26:20
text: ¶Come, my people, enter into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee; hide thyself just for a little moment, until the indignation be past.

title: Isaiah 26:21
text: For behold, Jehovah cometh out of his place to visit the iniquity of the inhabitants of the earth upon them; and the earth shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

title: Isaiah 27:1
text: ¶In that day Jehovah, with his sore and great and strong sword, will visit leviathan the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the crooked serpent; and he will slay the monster that is in the sea.

title: Isaiah 27:2
text: In that day [there shall be] a vineyard of pure wine; sing concerning it:

title: Isaiah 27:3
text: I Jehovah keep it, I will water it every moment; lest any harm it, I will keep it night and day.

title: Isaiah 27:4
text: Fury is not in me. Oh that I had briars [and] thorns in battle against me! I would march against them, I would burn them together.

title: Isaiah 27:5
text: Or let him take hold of my strength; let him make peace with me: [yea,] let him make peace with me.

title: Isaiah 27:6
text: In the future Jacob shall take root; Israel shall blossom and bud, and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit.

title: Isaiah 27:7
text: ¶Hath he smitten him according to the smiting of those that smote him? Is he slain according to the slaughter of those slain by him?

title: Isaiah 27:8
text: In measure, when sending her away, didst thou contend with her: he hath taken [her] away with his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

title: Isaiah 27:9
text: By this, therefore, shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit of the taking away of his sin: when he shall make all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are crumbled in pieces, --the Asherahs and the sun-images shall not stand.

title: Isaiah 27:10
text: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation abandoned and forsaken like a wilderness; there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume its boughs.

title: Isaiah 27:11
text: When its branches are withered they shall be broken off; women shall come [and] set them on fire. For it is a people of no intelligence; therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he who formed them will shew them no favour.

title: Isaiah 27:12
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah shall beat out from the flood of the river unto the torrent of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, [ye] children of Israel.

title: Isaiah 27:13
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the great trumpet shall be blown; and they shall come that were perishing in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and they shall worship Jehovah in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 28:1
text: ¶Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious adornment, which is on the head of the fat valley of them that are overcome with wine.

title: Isaiah 28:2
text: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, as a storm of hail [and] a destroying tempest; as a storm of mighty waters overflowing, shall he cast down to the earth with might.

title: Isaiah 28:3
text: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim shall be trodden under feet;

title: Isaiah 28:4
text: and the fading flower of his glorious adornment which is on the head of the fat valley shall be like an early fig before the summer: as soon as he that seeth it perceiveth it, scarcely is it in his hand, he swalloweth it down.

title: Isaiah 28:5
text: In that day will Jehovah of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the remnant of his people;

title: Isaiah 28:6
text: and for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

title: Isaiah 28:7
text: But these also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are they gone astray. The priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink; they are overpowered by wine, they are gone astray through strong drink; they have erred in vision, they have stumbled [in] judgment.

title: Isaiah 28:8
text: For all tables are full of filthy vomit, so that there is no [more] place.

title: Isaiah 28:9
text: ¶Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand the report? Them that are weaned from the milk, withdrawn from the breasts?

title: Isaiah 28:10
text: For [it is] precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little. ...

title: Isaiah 28:11
text: For with stammering lips and a strange tongue will he speak to this people;

title: Isaiah 28:12
text: to whom he said, This is the rest: cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing. But they would not hear.

title: Isaiah 28:13
text: And the word of Jehovah was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept, line upon line, line upon line, here a little, there a little: that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

title: Isaiah 28:14
text: ¶Therefore hear the word of Jehovah, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 28:15
text: For ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol have we made an agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us; for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves.

title: Isaiah 28:16
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I lay for foundation in Zion a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner-stone, a sure foundation: he that trusteth shall not make haste.

title: Isaiah 28:17
text: And I will appoint judgment for a line, and righteousness for a plummet; and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding-place.

title: Isaiah 28:18
text: And your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, ye shall be trodden down by it.

title: Isaiah 28:19
text: As it passeth through it shall take you; for morning by morning shall it pass through, by day and by night; and it shall be terror only to understand the report.

title: Isaiah 28:20
text: For the bed is too short to stretch oneself on, and the covering too narrow when he would wrap himself in it.

title: Isaiah 28:21
text: For Jehovah will rise up as on mount Perazim, he will be moved with anger as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his strange work, and perform his act, his unwonted act.

title: Isaiah 28:22
text: Now therefore be ye not scorners, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard from the Lord Jehovah of hosts a consumption, and [one] determined, upon the whole land.

title: Isaiah 28:23
text: ¶Give ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

title: Isaiah 28:24
text: Doth the ploughman plough all day to sow? Is he [all day] opening and breaking the clods of his land?

title: Isaiah 28:25
text: Doth he not, when he hath levelled the face thereof, cast abroad dill, and scatter cummin, and set the wheat in rows, and the barley in an appointed place, and the rye in its border?

title: Isaiah 28:26
text: His God doth instruct him in [his] judgment, he doth teach him.

title: Isaiah 28:27
text: For the dill is not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart-wheel turned about upon the cummin; but dill is beaten out with a staff, and cummin with a rod.

title: Isaiah 28:28
text: Bread [corn] is crushed, because he will not ever be threshing it; and if he drove the wheels of his cart and his horses [over it], he would not crush it.

title: Isaiah 28:29
text: This also cometh forth from Jehovah of hosts; he is wonderful in counsel, great in wisdom.

title: Isaiah 29:1
text: ¶Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city of David's encampment! Add ye year to year; let the feasts come round.

title: Isaiah 29:2
text: But I will distress Ariel, and there shall be sorrow and sadness; and it shall be unto me as an Ariel.

title: Isaiah 29:3
text: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with watch-posts, and I will raise forts against thee.

title: Isaiah 29:4
text: And thou shalt be brought low, thou shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall come low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

title: Isaiah 29:5
text: And the multitude of thine enemies shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones as chaff that passeth away; and it shall be in an instant, suddenly.

title: Isaiah 29:6
text: Thou shalt be visited by Jehovah of hosts with thunder and with earthquake and great noise, with whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

title: Isaiah 29:7
text: And the multitude of all the nations that war against Ariel, even all that war against her and her fortifications, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

title: Isaiah 29:8
text: It shall even be as when the hungry dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; and he awaketh, and his soul is empty; or as when the thirsty dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; and he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul craveth: so shall the multitude of all the nations be that war against mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 29:9
text: ¶Be astounded and astonished, blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

title: Isaiah 29:10
text: For Jehovah hath poured out upon you a spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes; the prophets and your chiefs, the seers, hath he covered.

title: Isaiah 29:11
text: And the whole vision is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which they give to one that can read, saying, Read this, I pray thee; and he saith, I cannot, for it is sealed.

title: Isaiah 29:12
text: And they give the book to him that cannot read, saying, Read this, I pray thee; and he saith, I cannot read.

title: Isaiah 29:13
text: And the Lord saith, Forasmuch as this people draw near with their mouth, and honour me with their lips, but their heart is removed far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment taught of men;

title: Isaiah 29:14
text: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do marvellously with this people, to do marvellously, even with wonder, and the wisdom of their wise [men] shall perish, and the understanding of their intelligent ones shall be hid.

title: Isaiah 29:15
text: Woe unto them that hide deep, far from Jehovah, their counsel! And their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

title: Isaiah 29:16
text: [Oh] your perverseness! --Shall the potter be esteemed as the clay, so that the work should say of him that made it, He made me not; or the thing formed say of him that formed it, He hath no understanding?

title: Isaiah 29:17
text: ¶Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

title: Isaiah 29:18
text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and, out of obscurity and out of darkness, the eyes of the blind shall see;

title: Isaiah 29:19
text: and the meek shall increase their joy in Jehovah, and the needy among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 29:20
text: For the terrible one shall come to nought, and the scorner shall be no more, and all that watch for iniquity shall be cut off,

title: Isaiah 29:21
text: that make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and pervert [the judgment of] the righteous by futility.

title: Isaiah 29:22
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now be pale;

title: Isaiah 29:23
text: for when he seeth his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they shall hallow my name, and hallow the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 29:24
text: And they that are of erring spirit shall know understanding, and the disobedient shall learn doctrine.

title: Isaiah 30:1
text: ¶Woe to the rebellious children, saith Jehovah, who take counsel, but not of me, and who make leagues, but not by my Spirit, that they may heap sin upon sin;

title: Isaiah 30:2
text: who walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked of my mouth, --to take refuge under the protection of Pharaoh, and trust in the shadow of Egypt!

title: Isaiah 30:3
text: For to you the protection of Pharaoh shall be a shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt a confusion.

title: Isaiah 30:4
text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

title: Isaiah 30:5
text: They were all ashamed of a people [that] did not profit them, nor were a help or profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

title: Isaiah 30:6
text: --The burden of the beasts of the south: Through a land of trouble and anguish, whence come the lioness and lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches upon the shoulders of asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to the people that shall not profit [them].

title: Isaiah 30:7
text: For Egypt shall help in vain, and to no purpose; therefore have I named her, Arrogance, that doeth nothing.

title: Isaiah 30:8
text: ¶Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and record it in a book, that it may be for the time to come, as a witness for ever,

title: Isaiah 30:9
text: that this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of Jehovah;

title: Isaiah 30:10
text: who say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things; speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits;

title: Isaiah 30:11
text: get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us!

title: Isaiah 30:12
text: Therefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel: Because ye reject this word, and confide in oppression and wilfulness, and depend thereon,

title: Isaiah 30:13
text: therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a towering wall, whose breaking shall come suddenly in an instant.

title: Isaiah 30:14
text: And he shall break it as the breaking of a potter's vessel, that is broken in pieces unsparingly; and in the pieces of it there shall not be found a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to scoop water out of the cistern.

title: Isaiah 30:15
text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel: In returning and rest shall ye be saved, in quietness and confidence shall be your strength; but ye would not.

title: Isaiah 30:16
text: And ye said, No, but we will flee upon horses, --therefore shall ye flee; and, We will ride upon the swift, --therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

title: Isaiah 30:17
text: One thousand [shall flee] at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as a banner on a hill.

title: Isaiah 30:18
text: ¶And therefore will Jehovah wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he lift himself up, that he may have mercy upon you; for Jehovah is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

title: Isaiah 30:19
text: For the people shall dwell in Zion, at Jerusalem. Thou shalt weep no more; he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; as he heareth it, he will answer thee.

title: Isaiah 30:20
text: And the Lord will give you the bread of adversity, and the water of oppression; yet thy teachers shall not be hidden any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers.

title: Isaiah 30:21
text: And when ye turn to the right hand or when ye turn to the left, thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it.

title: Isaiah 30:22
text: And ye shall defile the silver covering of your graven images, and the gold overlaying of your molten images; thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth: Out! shalt thou say unto it.

title: Isaiah 30:23
text: And he will give the rain of thy seed with which thou shalt sow the ground; and bread, the produce of the ground, and it shall be fat and rich. In that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures;

title: Isaiah 30:24
text: and the oxen and the asses that till the ground shall eat salted provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

title: Isaiah 30:25
text: And there shall be upon every high mountain and upon every hill that is lifted up, brooks [and] water-courses, in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

title: Isaiah 30:26
text: And the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that Jehovah bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the wound of their stroke.

title: Isaiah 30:27
text: ¶Behold, the name of Jehovah cometh from far, burning [with] his anger--a grievous conflagration; his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a consuming fire;

title: Isaiah 30:28
text: and his breath as an overflowing torrent, which reacheth even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction, and [to put] a bridle into the jaws of the peoples, that causeth them to go astray.

title: Isaiah 30:29
text: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a feast is sanctified; and joy of heart, as of one who goeth with a pipe to come unto the mountain of Jehovah, to the Rock of Israel.

title: Isaiah 30:30
text: And Jehovah will cause the majesty of his voice to be heard, and will shew the lighting down of his arm with indignation of anger, and a flame of consuming fire, with waterflood and storm and hailstones.

title: Isaiah 30:31
text: For through the voice of Jehovah shall the Assyrian be broken down: he will smite [him] with the rod.

title: Isaiah 30:32
text: And wherever shall pass the appointed staff, which Jehovah shall lay upon him, it shall be with tambours and harps; and with tumultuous battles will he fight with it.

title: Isaiah 30:33
text: For Topheth is prepared of old; for the king also it is prepared: he hath made it deep and large; its pile is fire and much wood; the breath of Jehovah, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

title: Isaiah 31:1
text: ¶Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help, and depend on horses, and confide in chariots because [they are] many, and in horsemen because they are very strong; and who look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek Jehovah!

title: Isaiah 31:2
text: But he also is wise, and he bringeth evil, and recalleth not his words; and he will arise against the house of evildoers, and against the help of workers of iniquity.

title: Isaiah 31:3
text: And the Egyptians are men, and not *God, and their horses flesh, and not spirit; and Jehovah shall stretch forth his hand, and he that helpeth shall stumble, and he that is helped shall fall, and they all shall perish together.

title: Isaiah 31:4
text: For thus hath Jehovah said unto me: Like as the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, is not afraid of their voice, nor giveth way before the multitude of them; so will Jehovah of hosts come down to war upon mount Zion, and on the hill thereof.

title: Isaiah 31:5
text: As birds with outstretched wings, so will Jehovah of hosts cover Jerusalem; covering, he will also deliver, passing over, he will rescue [it].

title: Isaiah 31:6
text: ¶Turn unto him from whom ye have deeply revolted, ye children of Israel;

title: Isaiah 31:7
text: for in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold, which your sinful hands have made unto you.

title: Isaiah 31:8
text: And Asshur shall fall by the sword, not of a great man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: and he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall become tributary;

title: Isaiah 31:9
text: and for fear, he shall pass over to his rock, and his princes shall be afraid of the banner, saith Jehovah, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 32:1
text: ¶Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

title: Isaiah 32:2
text: And a man shall be as a hiding-place from the wind, and a covert from the storm; as brooks of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a thirsty land.

title: Isaiah 32:3
text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken;

title: Isaiah 32:4
text: and the heart of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

title: Isaiah 32:5
text: The vile man shall be no more called noble, nor the churl said to be bountiful:

title: Isaiah 32:6
text: for the vile man will speak villainy, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against Jehovah, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

title: Isaiah 32:7
text: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the meek with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

title: Isaiah 32:8
text: But the noble deviseth noble things; and to noble things doth he stand.

title: Isaiah 32:9
text: ¶Rise up, ye women that are at ease, hear my voice; ye careless daughters, give ear unto my speech.

title: Isaiah 32:10
text: In a year and [some] days shall ye be troubled, ye careless women; for the vintage shall fail, the ingathering shall not come.

title: Isaiah 32:11
text: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones; strip you, and make you bare, and gird [sackcloth] on your loins!

title: Isaiah 32:12
text: They shall smite on the breasts [in lamentation] for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vineyards.

title: Isaiah 32:13
text: Upon the land of my people shall come up thistles [and] briars, yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

title: Isaiah 32:14
text: For the palace shall be deserted, the multitude of the city shall be forsaken; hill and watchtower shall be caves for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

title: Isaiah 32:15
text: until the Spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness become a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

title: Isaiah 32:16
text: And judgment shall inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness dwell in the fruitful field.

title: Isaiah 32:17
text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and assurance for ever.

title: Isaiah 32:18
text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting-places.

title: Isaiah 32:19
text: And it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

title: Isaiah 32:20
text: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth the feet of the ox and the ass.

title: Isaiah 33:1
text: ¶Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and that dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! When thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; when thou shalt make an end of dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

title: Isaiah 33:2
text: Jehovah, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be their arm every morning, yea, our salvation in the time of trouble.

title: Isaiah 33:3
text: At the noise of the tumult the peoples fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

title: Isaiah 33:4
text: And your spoil shall be gathered [like] the gathering of the caterpillar: as the running of locusts shall they run upon it.

title: Isaiah 33:5
text: Jehovah is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with justice and righteousness;

title: Isaiah 33:6
text: and he shall be the stability of thy times, the riches of salvation, wisdom and knowledge: the fear of Jehovah shall be your treasure.

title: Isaiah 33:7
text: Behold, their valiant ones cry without; the messengers of peace weep bitterly.

title: Isaiah 33:8
text: The highways are desolate, the wayfaring man ceaseth. He hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

title: Isaiah 33:9
text: The land mourneth, it languisheth; Lebanon is ashamed, is withered; the Sharon is become as a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped.

title: Isaiah 33:10
text: Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; now will I be exalted, now will I lift up myself.

title: Isaiah 33:11
text: Ye shall conceive dry grass, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath shall devour you [as] fire.

title: Isaiah 33:12
text: And the peoples shall be [as] burnings of lime, [as] thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

title: Isaiah 33:13
text: ¶Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

title: Isaiah 33:14
text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling hath surprised the hypocrites: Who among us shall dwell with the consuming fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting flames?

title: Isaiah 33:15
text: --He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from taking hold of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil:

title: Isaiah 33:16
text: he shall dwell on high, the fortresses of the rocks shall be his high retreat; bread shall be given him, his water shall be sure.

title: Isaiah 33:17
text: Thine eyes shall see the King in his beauty; they shall behold the land that is far off.

title: Isaiah 33:18
text: Thy heart shall meditate on terror: Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

title: Isaiah 33:19
text: Thou shalt no more see the fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst comprehend, of a stammering tongue that cannot be understood.

title: Isaiah 33:20
text: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tent that shall not be removed, the stakes whereof shall never be pulled up, neither shall any of its cords be broken;

title: Isaiah 33:21
text: but there Jehovah is unto us glorious, --a place of rivers, of broad streams: no galley with oars shall go there, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

title: Isaiah 33:22
text: For Jehovah is our judge, Jehovah, our lawgiver, Jehovah, our king: he will save us.

title: Isaiah 33:23
text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they strengthen not the socket of their mast, they cannot spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

title: Isaiah 33:24
text: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven [their] iniquity.

title: Isaiah 34:1
text: ¶Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye peoples: let the earth hear, and all its fulness; the world, and all that cometh forth of it.

title: Isaiah 34:2
text: For the wrath of Jehovah is against all the nations, and [his] fury against all their armies: he hath devoted them to destruction, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

title: Isaiah 34:3
text: And their slain shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up from their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

title: Isaiah 34:4
text: And all the host of the heavens shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll; and all their host shall fade away, as a leaf fadeth from off the vine, and as the withered [fruit] from the fig-tree.

title: Isaiah 34:5
text: For my sword is bathed in the heavens; behold, it shall come down upon Edom, and upon the people of my ban, to judgment.

title: Isaiah 34:6
text: The sword of Jehovah is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Jehovah hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

title: Isaiah 34:7
text: And the buffaloes shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

title: Isaiah 34:8
