text: ¶And let not the son of the alien, that hath joined himself to Jehovah, speak saying, Jehovah hath entirely separated me from his people; neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree;

title: Isaiah 56:4
text: for thus saith Jehovah: Unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,

title: Isaiah 56:5
text: even unto them will I give in my house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

title: Isaiah 56:6
text: Also the sons of the alien, that join themselves to Jehovah, to minister unto him and to love the name of Jehovah, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and holdeth fast to my covenant;

title: Isaiah 56:7
text: even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer; their burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar: for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all the peoples.

title: Isaiah 56:8
text: The Lord Jehovah, who gathereth the outcasts of Israel, saith: Yet will I gather [others] to him, with those of his that are gathered.

title: Isaiah 56:9
text: ¶All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, all ye beasts in the forest.

title: Isaiah 56:10
text: His watchmen are all of them blind, they are without knowledge; they are all dumb dogs that cannot bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber:

title: Isaiah 56:11
text: and the dogs are greedy, they know not to be satisfied, and these are shepherds that know not how to discern: they all turn to their own way, every one for his gain, even to the last of them:

title: Isaiah 56:12
text: Come, [say they,] I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to-morrow shall be as this day, [and] much more abundant.

title: Isaiah 57:1
text: ¶The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart; and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from before the evil.

title: Isaiah 57:2
text: He entereth into peace: they rest in their beds, [each one] that hath walked in his uprightness.

title: Isaiah 57:3
text: ¶But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the harlot.

title: Isaiah 57:4
text: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? Against whom do ye make a wide mouth, [and] draw out the tongue? Are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

title: Isaiah 57:5
text: inflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clefts of the rocks?

title: Isaiah 57:6
text: Among the smooth [stones] of the torrent is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured out a drink-offering, thou hast offered an oblation. Shall I be comforted myself as to these things?

title: Isaiah 57:7
text: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither didst thou go up to offer sacrifice.

title: Isaiah 57:8
text: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for apart from me, thou hast uncovered thyself, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and hast made agreement with them; thou lovedst their bed, thou sawest their nakedness.

title: Isaiah 57:9
text: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst multiply thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers afar off, and didst debase thyself unto Sheol.

title: Isaiah 57:10
text: Thou wast wearied by the multitude of thy ways; [but] thou saidst not, It is of no avail. Thou didst find a quickening of thy strength; therefore thou wast not sick [of it].

title: Isaiah 57:11
text: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor taken it to heart? Have not I even of long time held my peace, and thou fearest me not?

title: Isaiah 57:12
text: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; and they shall not profit thee.

title: Isaiah 57:13
text: ¶When thou criest, let them that are gathered by thee deliver thee! But a wind shall carry them all away, a breath shall take them; but he that putteth his trust in me shall inherit the land, and possess my holy mountain.

title: Isaiah 57:14
text: And it shall be said, Cast up, cast up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-blocks out of the way of my people.

title: Isaiah 57:15
text: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, and whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy [place], and with him that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

title: Isaiah 57:16
text: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth; for the spirit would fail before me, and the souls [which] I have made.

title: Isaiah 57:17
text: ¶For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him; I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on backslidingly in the way of his heart.

title: Isaiah 57:18
text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him; and I will lead him, and will restore comforts unto him and to those of his that mourn.

title: Isaiah 57:19
text: I create the fruit of the lips: peace, peace to him [that is] afar off, and to him [that is] nigh, saith Jehovah; and I will heal him.

title: Isaiah 57:20
text: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, which cannot rest, and whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

title: Isaiah 57:21
text: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

title: Isaiah 58:1
text: ¶Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and declare unto my people their transgression, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

title: Isaiah 58:2
text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that doeth righteousness, and hath not forsaken the ordinance of their God; they ask of me the ordinances of righteousness, they take delight in approaching to God:

title: Isaiah 58:3
text: ¶--Wherefore have we fasted, and thou seest not; have afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find what pleaseth [you], and exact all your labours.

title: Isaiah 58:4
text: Behold, ye have fasted for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness; ye do not at present fast, to cause your voice to be heard on high.

title: Isaiah 58:5
text: Is such the fast that I have chosen, a day for a man to afflict his soul, --that he should bow down his head as a bulrush, and spread sackcloth and ashes [under him]? Wilt thou call this a fast, and a day acceptable to Jehovah?

title: Isaiah 58:6
text: Is not this the fast which I have chosen: to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the thongs of the yoke, and to send forth free the crushed, and that ye break every yoke?

title: Isaiah 58:7
text: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring to thy house the needy wanderers; when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

title: Isaiah 58:8
text: ¶Then shall thy light break forth as the dawn, and thy health shall spring forth speedily; and thy righteousness shall go before thee, the glory of Jehovah shall be thy rearguard.

title: Isaiah 58:9
text: Then shalt thou call, and Jehovah will answer; thou shalt cry, and he will say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger and the unjust speech,

title: Isaiah 58:10
text: and thou proffer thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul: then shall thy light rise in the darkness, and thine obscurity be as midday;

title: Isaiah 58:11
text: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and strengthen thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a water-spring, whose waters deceive not.

title: Isaiah 58:12
text: And they [that come] of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations [that have remained] from generation to generation; and thou shalt be called, Repairer of the breaches, restorer of frequented paths.

title: Isaiah 58:13
text: ¶If thou turn back thy foot from the sabbath, [from] doing thy pleasure on my holy day, and call the sabbath a delight, the holy [day] of Jehovah, honourable; and thou honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking [idle] words;

title: Isaiah 58:14
text: then shalt thou delight thyself in Jehovah, and I will cause thee to ride on the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Isaiah 59:1
text: ¶Behold, Jehovah's hand is not shortened that it cannot save, neither his ear heavy that it cannot hear;

title: Isaiah 59:2
text: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid [his] face from you, that he doth not hear.

title: Isaiah 59:3
text: For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips speak lies, your tongue muttereth unrighteousness:

title: Isaiah 59:4
text: none calleth for justice, none pleadeth in truthfulness. They trust in vanity, and speak falsehood; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

title: Isaiah 59:5
text: They hatch serpents' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

title: Isaiah 59:6
text: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works; their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

title: Isaiah 59:7
text: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths;

title: Isaiah 59:8
text: the way of peace they know not, and there is no judgment in their goings; they have made their paths crooked: whoso goeth therein knoweth not peace.

title: Isaiah 59:9
text: ¶Therefore is justice far from us, and righteousness overtaketh us not: we wait for light, and behold darkness; for brightness, [but] we walk in obscurity.

title: Isaiah 59:10
text: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at midday as in the twilight; amongst the flourishing we are as the dead.

title: Isaiah 59:11
text: We roar all like bears, and mourn grievously like doves: we look for judgment, and there is none; for salvation, [but] it is far from us.

title: Isaiah 59:12
text: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us; and our iniquities, we know them:

title: Isaiah 59:13
text: in transgressing and lying against Jehovah, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

title: Isaiah 59:14
text: And judgment is turned away backward, and righteousness standeth afar off; for truth stumbleth in the street, and uprightness cannot enter.

title: Isaiah 59:15
text: And truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey. And Jehovah saw [it], and it was evil in his sight that there was no judgment.

title: Isaiah 59:16
text: ¶And he saw that there was no man, and he wondered that there was no intercessor; and his arm brought him salvation, and his righteousness, it sustained him.

title: Isaiah 59:17
text: And he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on garments of vengeance [for] clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.

title: Isaiah 59:18
text: According to deeds, so will he repay: fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

title: Isaiah 59:19
text: And they shall fear the name of Jehovah from the west, and from the rising of the sun, his glory. When the adversary shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of Jehovah will lift up a banner against him.

title: Isaiah 59:20
text: And the Redeemer will come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 59:21
text: And as for me, this is my covenant with them, saith Jehovah: My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith Jehovah, from henceforth and for ever.

title: Isaiah 60:1
text: ¶Arise, shine! for thy light is come, and the glory of Jehovah is risen upon thee.

title: Isaiah 60:2
text: For behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the peoples; but Jehovah will arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen on thee.

title: Isaiah 60:3
text: And the nations shall walk by thy light, and kings by the brightness of thy rising.

title: Isaiah 60:4
text: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons come from afar, and thy daughters are carried upon the side.

title: Isaiah 60:5
text: Then thou shalt see, and shalt be brightened, and thy heart shall throb, and be enlarged; for the abundance of the sea shall be turned unto thee, the wealth of the nations shall come unto thee.

title: Isaiah 60:6
text: A multitude of camels shall cover thee, young camels of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall publish the praises of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 60:7
text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall serve thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will beautify the house of my magnificence.

title: Isaiah 60:8
text: Who are these that come flying as a cloud, and as doves to their dove-cotes?

title: Isaiah 60:9
text: ¶For the isles shall await me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from afar, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of Jehovah thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, for he hath glorified thee.

title: Isaiah 60:10
text: And the sons of the alien shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee. For in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

title: Isaiah 60:11
text: And thy gates shall stand open continually: (they shall not be shut day nor night,) that the wealth of the nations may be brought unto thee, and that their kings may be led [to thee].

title: Isaiah 60:12
text: For the nation and the kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; and those nations shall be utterly wasted.

title: Isaiah 60:13
text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the cypress, pine, and box-tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

title: Isaiah 60:14
text: And the children of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee The city of Jehovah, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 60:15
text: ¶Instead of thy being forsaken and hated, so that no one went through [thee], I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy from generation to generation.

title: Isaiah 60:16
text: And thou shalt suck the milk of the nations, and shalt suck the breast of kings; and thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, [am] thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

title: Isaiah 60:17
text: For bronze I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood bronze, and for stones iron; and I will make thine officers peace, and thy rulers righteousness.

title: Isaiah 60:18
text: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

title: Isaiah 60:19
text: The sun shall be no more thy light by day, neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee; but Jehovah shall be thine everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

title: Isaiah 60:20
text: Thy sun shall no more go down, neither shall thy moon withdraw itself; for Jehovah shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

title: Isaiah 60:21
text: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall possess the land for ever--the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

title: Isaiah 60:22
text: The little one shall become a thousand, and the smallest a mighty nation: I, Jehovah, will hasten it in its time.

title: Isaiah 61:1
text: ¶The Spirit of the Lord Jehovah is upon me, because Jehovah hath anointed me to announce glad tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and opening of the prison to them that are bound;

title: Isaiah 61:2
text: to proclaim the acceptable year of Jehovah, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

title: Isaiah 61:3
text: to appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, that beauty should be given unto them instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of the spirit of heaviness: that they might be called terebinths of righteousness, the planting of Jehovah, that he may be glorified.

title: Isaiah 61:4
text: ¶And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the places desolate from generation to generation.

title: Isaiah 61:5
text: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your ploughmen and your vinedressers.

title: Isaiah 61:6
text: But as for you, ye shall be called priests of Jehovah; it shall be said of you: Ministers of our God. Ye shall eat the wealth of the nations, and into their glory shall ye enter.

title: Isaiah 61:7
text: Instead of your shame [ye shall have] double; instead of confusion they shall celebrate with joy their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double; everlasting joy shall be unto them.

title: Isaiah 61:8
text: For I, Jehovah, love judgment, I hate robbery with wrong; and I will give their recompence in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

title: Isaiah 61:9
text: And their seed shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are a seed that Jehovah hath blessed.

title: Isaiah 61:10
text: ¶I will greatly rejoice in Jehovah, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with the priestly turban, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

title: Isaiah 61:11
text: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as a garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth, so the Lord Jehovah will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

title: Isaiah 62:1
text: ¶For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not be still, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a torch that burneth.

title: Isaiah 62:2
text: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory; and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah will name.

title: Isaiah 62:3
text: And thou shalt be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

title: Isaiah 62:4
text: Thou shalt no more be termed, Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed, Desolate: but thou shalt be called, My delight is in her, and thy land, Married; for Jehovah delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

title: Isaiah 62:5
text: For [as] a young man marrieth a virgin, shall thy sons marry thee; and with the joy of the bridegroom over the bride, shall thy God rejoice over thee.

title: Isaiah 62:6
text: ¶I have set watchmen upon thy walls, Jerusalem; all the day and all the night they shall never hold their peace: ye that put Jehovah in remembrance, keep not silence,

title: Isaiah 62:7
text: and give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

title: Isaiah 62:8
text: Jehovah hath sworn by his right hand and by the arm of his strength, I will indeed no more give thy corn [to be] food for thine enemies; and the sons of the alien shall not drink thy new wine, for which thou hast laboured;

title: Isaiah 62:9
text: for they that have garnered it shall eat it, and praise Jehovah; and they that have gathered it shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

title: Isaiah 62:10
text: ¶Go through, go through the gates; prepare the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a banner for the peoples.

title: Isaiah 62:11
text: Behold, Jehovah hath proclaimed unto the end of the earth, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompence before him.

title: Isaiah 62:12
text: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of Jehovah; and thou shalt be called, The sought out, The city not forsaken.

title: Isaiah 63:1
text: ¶Who is this that cometh from Edom, with deep-red garments from Bozrah, this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? --I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

title: Isaiah 63:2
text: --Wherefore is redness in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winevat?

title: Isaiah 63:3
text: I have trodden the winepress alone, and of the peoples not a man was with me; and I have trodden them in mine anger, and trampled them in my fury; and their blood is sprinkled upon my garments, and I have stained all mine apparel.

title: Isaiah 63:4
text: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed had come.

title: Isaiah 63:5
text: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: and mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

title: Isaiah 63:6
text: And I have trodden down the peoples in mine anger, and made them drunk in my fury; and their blood have I brought down to the earth.

title: Isaiah 63:7
text: ¶I will record the loving-kindnesses of Jehovah, the praises of Jehovah, according to all that Jehovah hath bestowed upon us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel which he hath bestowed upon them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses.

title: Isaiah 63:8
text: And he said, They are indeed my people, children that will not lie; and he became their Saviour.

title: Isaiah 63:9
text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the Angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bore them and carried them all the days of old.

title: Isaiah 63:10
text: But they rebelled and grieved his holy Spirit: and he turned to be their enemy; himself, he fought against them.

title: Isaiah 63:11
text: But he remembered the days of old, Moses [and] his people: Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he that put his holy Spirit within him,

title: Isaiah 63:12
text: his glorious arm leading them by the right hand of Moses, dividing the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name,

title: Isaiah 63:13
text: --who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, [and] they stumbled not?

title: Isaiah 63:14
text: As cattle go down into the valley, the Spirit of Jehovah gave them rest; so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

title: Isaiah 63:15
text: ¶Look down from the heavens, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory! Where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy tender mercies? Are they restrained toward me?

title: Isaiah 63:16
text: For thou art our Father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, Jehovah, art our Father; our Redeemer, from everlasting, is thy name.

title: Isaiah 63:17
text: Why, O Jehovah, hast thou made us to err from thy ways, hast hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

title: Isaiah 63:18
text: Thy holy people have possessed [it] but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

title: Isaiah 63:19
text: We have become [like those] over whom thou never barest rule, those not called by thy name.

title: Isaiah 64:1
text: ¶Oh, that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, --that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

title: Isaiah 64:2
text: --as fire kindleth brushwood, as the fire causeth water to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations might tremble at thy presence!

title: Isaiah 64:3
text: When thou didst terrible things [which] we looked not for, thou camest down, and the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

title: Isaiah 64:4
text: Never have [men] heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor hath eye seen a God beside thee, who acteth for him that waiteth for him.

title: Isaiah 64:5
text: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth to do righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: (behold, thou wast wroth, and we have sinned:) in those is perpetuity, and we shall be saved.

title: Isaiah 64:6
text: ¶And we are all become as an unclean [thing], and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all fade as a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, have carried us away;

title: Isaiah 64:7
text: and there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee; for thou hast hidden thy face from us, and hast caused us to melt away through our iniquities.

title: Isaiah 64:8
text: And now, Jehovah, thou art our Father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

title: Isaiah 64:9
text: Be not wroth very sore, O Jehovah, neither remember iniquity for ever. Behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.

title: Isaiah 64:10
text: Thy holy cities are become a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

title: Isaiah 64:11
text: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burnt up with fire, and all our precious things are laid waste.

title: Isaiah 64:12
text: Wilt thou restrain thyself in presence of these things, Jehovah? Wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

title: Isaiah 65:1
text: ¶I am sought out of them that inquired not [for me], I am found of them that sought me not; I have said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.

title: Isaiah 65:2
text: I have stretched out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, who walk in a way not good, after their own thoughts;

title: Isaiah 65:3
text: the people that provoke me to anger continually to my face, sacrificing in gardens and burning incense upon the bricks;

title: Isaiah 65:4
text: who sit down among the graves, and lodge in the secret places; who eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things [is in] their vessels;

title: Isaiah 65:5
text: who say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

title: Isaiah 65:6
text: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

title: Isaiah 65:7
text: your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith Jehovah, who have burned incense upon the mountains, and outraged me upon the hills; and I will measure their former work into their bosom.

title: Isaiah 65:8
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah: As the new wine is found in the cluster, and it is said, Destroy it not, for a blessing is in it; so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy [them] all.

title: Isaiah 65:9
text: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah a possessor of my mountains; and mine elect shall possess it, and my servants shall dwell there.

title: Isaiah 65:10
text: And the Sharon shall be a fold for flocks, and the valley of Achor a couching-place of the herds, for my people that have sought me.

title: Isaiah 65:11
text: ¶But ye who forsake Jehovah, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Gad, and fill up mixed wine unto Meni:

title: Isaiah 65:12
text: I will even assign you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down in the slaughter; because I called, and ye did not answer, I spoke, and ye did not hear; but ye did what was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delight not.

title: Isaiah 65:13
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, my servants shall eat, and *ye* shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, and *ye* shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, and *ye* shall be ashamed;

title: Isaiah 65:14
text: behold, my servants shall sing aloud for gladness of heart, and *ye* shall cry out for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

title: Isaiah 65:15
text: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto mine elect; for the Lord Jehovah will slay thee, and will call his servants by another name:

title: Isaiah 65:16
text: so that he who blesseth himself in the land shall bless himself by the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the land shall swear by the God of truth: because the former troubles shall be forgotten, and because they shall be hidden from mine eyes.

title: Isaiah 65:17
text: ¶For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

title: Isaiah 65:18
text: But be glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create. For behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

title: Isaiah 65:19
text: And I will rejoice over Jerusalem, and will joy in my people; and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

title: Isaiah 65:20
text: There shall be no more thenceforth an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not completed his days; for the youth shall die a hundred years old, and the sinner being a hundred years old shall be accursed.

title: Isaiah 65:21
text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof:

title: Isaiah 65:22
text: they shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree shall be the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

title: Isaiah 65:23
text: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for terror; for they are the seed of the blessed of Jehovah, and their offspring with them.

title: Isaiah 65:24
text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

title: Isaiah 65:25
text: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the ox; and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:1
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah: The heavens are my throne, and the earth is my footstool: what is the house that ye will build unto me? and what is the place of my rest?

title: Isaiah 66:2
text: Even all these things hath my hand made, and all these things have been, saith Jehovah. But to this man will I look: to the afflicted and contrite in spirit, and who trembleth at my word.

title: Isaiah 66:3
text: He that slaughtereth an ox, smiteth a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, breaketh a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, [it is as] swine's blood; he that presenteth a memorial of incense, [is as] he that blesseth an idol. As they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations,

title: Isaiah 66:4
text: I also will choose their calamities, and will bring their fears upon them; because I called, and none answered, I spoke, and they did not hear, but did that which was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delight not.

title: Isaiah 66:5
text: ¶Hear the word of Jehovah, ye that tremble at his word: Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let Jehovah be glorified, and let us see your joy! but they shall be ashamed.

title: Isaiah 66:6
text: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Jehovah that rendereth recompence to his enemies!

title: Isaiah 66:7
text: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man-child.

title: Isaiah 66:8
text: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Can a land be made to bring forth in one day? shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her sons.

title: Isaiah 66:9
text: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith Jehovah; I who cause to bring forth, shall I shut [the womb]? saith thy God.

title: Isaiah 66:10
text: Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all ye that love her; rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn over her:

title: Isaiah 66:11
text: because ye shall suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; because ye shall drink out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

title: Isaiah 66:12
text: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing torrent; and ye shall suck, ye shall be carried upon the side, and be dandled upon the knees.

title: Isaiah 66:13
text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 66:14
text: And ye shall see [this], and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like the grass; and the hand of Jehovah shall be known toward his servants, and he will have indignation toward his enemies.

title: Isaiah 66:15
text: ¶For behold, Jehovah will come with fire, and his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

title: Isaiah 66:16
text: For by fire and by his sword will Jehovah enter into judgment with all flesh: and the slain of Jehovah shall be many.

title: Isaiah 66:17
text: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one in the midst; that eat swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall perish together, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:18
text: And I, --their works and their thoughts [are before me]. ...[The time] cometh for the gathering of all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

title: Isaiah 66:19
text: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow; to Tubal and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory: and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

title: Isaiah 66:20
text: And they shall bring all your brethren out of all the nations as an oblation unto Jehovah, upon horses, and in chariots, and in covered waggons, and upon mules, and upon dromedaries, to my holy mountain, to Jerusalem, saith Jehovah, as the children of Israel bring an oblation in a clean vessel into the house of Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:21
text: And I will also take of them for priests [and] for Levites, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:22
text: For as the new heavens and the new earth which I will make shall remain before me, saith Jehovah, so shall your seed and your name remain.

title: Isaiah 66:23
text: And it shall come to pass from new moon to new moon, and from sabbath to sabbath, all flesh shall come to worship before me, saith Jehovah.

title: Isaiah 66:24
text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorrence unto all flesh.

title: Jeremiah 1:1
text: ¶The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkijah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

title: Jeremiah 1:2
text: to whom the word of Jehovah came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign;

title: Jeremiah 1:3
text: it came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive, in the fifth month.

title: Jeremiah 1:4
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 1:5
text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I hallowed thee, I appointed thee a prophet unto the nations.

title: Jeremiah 1:6
text: And I said, Alas, Lord Jehovah! behold, I cannot speak; for I am a child.

title: Jeremiah 1:7
text: But Jehovah said unto me, Say not, I am a child; for thou shalt go to whomsoever I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

title: Jeremiah 1:8
text: Be not afraid of them; for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 1:9
text: And Jehovah put forth his hand and touched my mouth; and Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

title: Jeremiah 1:10
text: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up, and to break down, and to destroy, and to overthrow, to build and to plant.

title: Jeremiah 1:11
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond-tree.

title: Jeremiah 1:12
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Thou hast well seen; for I am watchful over my word to perform it.

title: Jeremiah 1:13
text: And the word of Jehovah came to me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething-pot, and its face is from the north.

title: Jeremiah 1:14
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Out of the north shall evil break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

title: Jeremiah 1:15
text: For behold, I am calling all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith Jehovah, and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah:

title: Jeremiah 1:16
text: and I will pronounce my judgments against them for all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

title: Jeremiah 1:17
text: Thou, therefore, gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I shall command thee: be not dismayed at them, lest I cause thee to be dismayed before them.

title: Jeremiah 1:18
text: And I, behold, I appoint thee this day as a strong city, and an iron pillar, and brazen walls, against the whole land; against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

title: Jeremiah 1:19
text: And they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee, saith Jehovah, to deliver thee.

title: Jeremiah 2:1
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

title: Jeremiah 2:2
text: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: I remember for thee the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.

title: Jeremiah 2:3
text: Israel was holiness unto Jehovah, the first-fruits of his increase: all that devour him are guilty; evil shall come upon them, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:4
text: Hear the word of Jehovah, house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 2:5
text: Thus saith Jehovah: What injustice have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and become vain?

title: Jeremiah 2:6
text: And they said not, Where is Jehovah, that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us in the wilderness, in a land of deserts and of pits, in a land of drought and of the shadow of death, in a land that no one passeth through, and where no man dwelleth?

title: Jeremiah 2:7
text: And I brought you into a fruitful land, to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof; and ye entered and defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

title: Jeremiah 2:8
text: The priests said not, Where is Jehovah? and they that handled the law knew me not; and the shepherds transgressed against me; and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after [things that] do not profit.

title: Jeremiah 2:9
text: ¶Therefore will I yet plead with you, saith Jehovah, and with your children's children will I plead.

title: Jeremiah 2:10
text: For pass over to the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there have been such a thing.

title: Jeremiah 2:11
text: Hath a nation changed [its] gods? and they are no gods; --but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

title: Jeremiah 2:12
text: Be astonished, ye heavens, at this, and shudder; be amazed very much, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:13
text: For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, to hew them out cisterns, broken cisterns that hold no water.

title: Jeremiah 2:14
text: ¶Is Israel a bondman? Is he a home-born [slave]? Why is he become a spoil?

title: Jeremiah 2:15
text: The young lions roared against him, they gave forth their voice, and they made his land desolate: his cities are burned, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 2:16
text: Even the children of Noph and Tahapanes have fed on the crown of thy head.

title: Jeremiah 2:17
text: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken Jehovah thy God, at the time he was leading thee in the way?

title: Jeremiah 2:18
text: And now, what hast thou to do with the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Shihor? And what hast thou to do with the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

title: Jeremiah 2:19
text: Thine own wickedness chastiseth thee, and thy backslidings reprove thee: know then and see that it is an evil thing and bitter that thou hast forsaken Jehovah thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 2:20
text: ¶For of old thou hast broken thy yoke, [and] burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not serve. For upon every high hill, and under every green tree, thou bowest down, playing the harlot.

title: Jeremiah 2:21
text: And I, --I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed; how then art thou turned into the degenerate shoots of a strange vine unto me?

title: Jeremiah 2:22
text: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much potash, thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:23
text: How sayest thou, I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baals? See thy way in the valley, acknowledge what thou hast done--a swift dromedary traversing her ways!

title: Jeremiah 2:24
text: --a wild ass, used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind in her desire! In her ardour, who shall turn her away? All they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

title: Jeremiah 2:25
text: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst. But thou saidst, There is no hope; no, for I love strangers, and after them will I go.

title: Jeremiah 2:26
text: As a thief is ashamed when he is found, so shall the house of Israel be ashamed--they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets--

title: Jeremiah 2:27
text: saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth; for they have turned the back unto me, and not the face; and in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us!

title: Jeremiah 2:28
text: Where then are thy gods that thou hast made for thyself? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for as the number of thy cities, are thy gods, O Judah.

title: Jeremiah 2:29
text: ¶Wherefore would ye contend with me? Ye all have transgressed against me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 2:30
text: In vain have I smitten your children: they received no correction. Your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

title: Jeremiah 2:31
text: O generation, mark ye the word of Jehovah. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel, or a land of thick darkness? Wherefore say my people, We have dominion; we will come no more unto thee?

title: Jeremiah 2:32
text: Doth a virgin forget her ornaments, a bride her attire? But my people have forgotten me days without number.

title: Jeremiah 2:33
text: How dost thou trim thy way to seek love! Therefore hast thou also accustomed thy ways to wickedness.

title: Jeremiah 2:34
text: Yea, in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the innocent poor, whom thou didst not encounter breaking in, but [it is found] upon all these.

title: Jeremiah 2:35
text: And thou sayest, Indeed I am innocent; his anger will turn from me. Behold, I will enter into judgment with thee because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

title: Jeremiah 2:36
text: Why dost thou gad about so much, and change thy way? Thou shalt also be brought to shame by Egypt, as thou wast brought to shame by Assyria.

title: Jeremiah 2:37
text: Thou shalt indeed go forth from her with thy hands upon thy head; for Jehovah hath rejected those thou confidest in, and thou shalt not prosper by them.

title: Jeremiah 3:1
text: ¶They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? Would not that land be utterly polluted? But thou hast committed fornication with many lovers; yet return to me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:2
text: Lift up thine eyes unto the heights and see, where hast thou not been lain with? In the ways hast thou sat for them, as an Arab in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy fornications and with thy wickedness.

title: Jeremiah 3:3
text: And the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; but thou hast a harlot's forehead, thou refusest to be ashamed.

title: Jeremiah 3:4
text: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?

title: Jeremiah 3:5
text: Will he keep [his anger] for ever? Will he preserve it perpetually? Behold, thou hast spoken and hast done evil things, and thou art [so] determined.

title: Jeremiah 3:6
text: ¶And Jehovah said unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen what backsliding Israel hath done? She hath gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath committed fornication.

title: Jeremiah 3:7
text: And I said, After she hath done all these [things], she will return unto me; but she returned not. And her sister Judah, the treacherous, saw [it].

title: Jeremiah 3:8
text: And I saw that when for all the causes wherein backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce, yet the treacherous Judah, her sister, feared not, but went and committed fornication also.

title: Jeremiah 3:9
text: And it came to pass through the lightness of her fornication that she polluted the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

title: Jeremiah 3:10
text: And even for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not returned unto me with her whole heart, but with falsehood, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:11
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Backsliding Israel hath shewn herself more just than treacherous Judah.

title: Jeremiah 3:12
text: ¶Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith Jehovah: I will not make my face dark upon you; for I am merciful, saith Jehovah; I will not keep [anger] for ever.

title: Jeremiah 3:13
text: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against Jehovah thy God, and hast turned thy ways hither and thither to the strangers under every green tree; and ye have not hearkened to my voice, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:14
text: Return, backsliding children, saith Jehovah; for I am a husband unto you, and I will take you, one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

title: Jeremiah 3:15
text: And I will give you shepherds according to my heart, and they shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

title: Jeremiah 3:16
text: And it shall come to pass, when ye are multiplied in the land and become fruitful, in those days, saith Jehovah, they shall say no more, Ark of the covenant of Jehovah! neither shall it come to mind, nor shall they remember it, nor shall they visit [it]; neither shall it be done any more.

title: Jeremiah 3:17
text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of Jehovah; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of Jehovah, to Jerusalem; and they shall no more walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

title: Jeremiah 3:18
text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel; and they shall come together out of the land of the north, to the land which I caused your fathers to inherit.

title: Jeremiah 3:19
text: And as for me, I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee the pleasant land, the goodly inheritance of the hosts of the nations? And I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from following me.

title: Jeremiah 3:20
text: ¶Surely [as] a woman treacherously departeth from her companion, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 3:21
text: A voice is heard upon the heights, the weeping supplications of the children of Israel; for they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Jehovah their God.

title: Jeremiah 3:22
text: --Return, backsliding children; I will heal your backslidings. ...Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art Jehovah our God.

title: Jeremiah 3:23
text: Truly in vain [is salvation looked for] from the hills, [and] the multitude of mountains; truly in Jehovah our God is the salvation of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 3:24
text: But shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

title: Jeremiah 3:25
text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us; for we have sinned against Jehovah our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah our God.

title: Jeremiah 4:1
text: ¶If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith Jehovah, return unto me; and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not be a wanderer;

title: Jeremiah 4:2
text: --and thou shalt in truth, in justice, and in righteousness swear, [As] Jehovah liveth! and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

title: Jeremiah 4:3
text: ¶For thus saith Jehovah to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: Break up for you a fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

title: Jeremiah 4:4
text: Circumcise yourselves for Jehovah, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my fury come forth like fire and burn, and there be none to quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

title: Jeremiah 4:5
text: ¶Declare ye in Judah, and cause it to be heard in Jerusalem, and say, ...and blow the trumpet in the land, cry aloud and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fenced cities.

title: Jeremiah 4:6
text: Set up a banner toward Zion; take to flight, stay not! For I am bringing evil from the north, and a great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 4:7
text: The lion is come up from his thicket, the destroyer of the nations is on his way; he is gone forth from his place, to make thy land desolate; thy cities shall be laid waste, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 4:8
text: For this, gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl! for the fierce anger of Jehovah is not turned away from us.

title: Jeremiah 4:9
text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall be amazed.

title: Jeremiah 4:10
text: And I said, Alas, Lord Jehovah! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.

title: Jeremiah 4:11
text: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A hot wind [cometh] from the heights in the wilderness, on the way of the daughter of my people, not for fanning, nor for cleansing.

title: Jeremiah 4:12
text: A wind more vehement than that shall come from me: now will I also pronounce judgments against them.

title: Jeremiah 4:13
text: Behold, he cometh up as clouds, and his chariots are as a whirlwind; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are destroyed.

title: Jeremiah 4:14
text: Wash thy heart, Jerusalem, from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

title: Jeremiah 4:15
text: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

title: Jeremiah 4:16
text: Inform the nations; behold, make Jerusalem to hear: Besiegers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 4:17
text: As keepers of a field are they against her round about; for she hath been rebellious against me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 4:18
text: Thy way and thy doings have procured these [things] unto thee; this is thy wickedness, yea, it is bitter, yea, it reacheth unto thy heart.

title: Jeremiah 4:19
text: ¶My bowels! my bowels! I am in travail! [Oh,] the walls of my heart! My heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace: for thou hearest, my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the clamour of war.

title: Jeremiah 4:20
text: Destruction upon destruction is proclaimed; for the whole land is wasted: suddenly are my tents laid waste, my curtains, in a moment.

title: Jeremiah 4:21
text: How long shall I see the standard, [and] hear the sound of the trumpet?

title: Jeremiah 4:22
text: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have no intelligence; they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

title: Jeremiah 4:23
text: I beheld the earth, and lo, it was waste and empty; and the heavens, and they had no light.

title: Jeremiah 4:24
text: I beheld the mountains, and lo, they trembled, and all the hills shook violently.

title: Jeremiah 4:25
text: I beheld, and lo, man was not, and all the fowl of the heavens were fled.

title: Jeremiah 4:26
text: I beheld, and lo, the fruitful land was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down, before Jehovah, before his fierce anger.

title: Jeremiah 4:27
text: For thus saith Jehovah: The whole land shall be a desolation; but I will not make a full end.

title: Jeremiah 4:28
text: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black; because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back therefrom.

title: Jeremiah 4:29
text: At the noise of the horsemen and bowmen, every city fleeth; they go into the thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city is forsaken and no man dwelleth therein.

title: Jeremiah 4:30
text: --And thou, wasted one, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rendest thine eyes with paint, in vain dost thou make thyself fair: [thy] lovers despise thee, they seek thy life.

title: Jeremiah 4:31
text: For I hear a voice, as of a woman in travail, anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion: she moaneth, she spreadeth forth her hands, [saying], Woe unto me! for my soul faileth because of murderers.

title: Jeremiah 5:1
text: ¶Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broadways thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be [any] that doeth justice, that seeketh fidelity; and I will pardon it.

title: Jeremiah 5:2
text: And if they say, [As] Jehovah liveth! surely they swear falsely.

title: Jeremiah 5:3
text: Jehovah, are not thine eyes upon fidelity? Thou hast smitten them, but they are not sore; thou hast consumed them, they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

title: Jeremiah 5:4
text: And I said, Surely these are the wretched ones, they are foolish; for they know not the way of Jehovah, the judgment of their God.

title: Jeremiah 5:5
text: I will go unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they know the way of Jehovah, the judgment of their God; but these have altogether broken the yoke, have burst the bonds.

title: Jeremiah 5:6
text: Therefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the evenings shall waste them; the leopard lurketh against their cities, every one that goeth out thence is torn in pieces: for their transgressions are multiplied, their backslidings are increased.

title: Jeremiah 5:7
text: Wherefore should I pardon thee? Thy children have forsaken me, and swear by them that are not God. I have satiated them, and they have committed adultery, and they troop to the harlots' house.

title: Jeremiah 5:8
text: [As] well fed horses, they roam about, every one neigheth after his neighbour's wife.

title: Jeremiah 5:9
text: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah, and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 5:10
text: ¶Go up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end; take away her battlements, for they are not Jehovah's.

title: Jeremiah 5:11
text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 5:12
text: They have denied Jehovah, and say, He is not; and evil shall not come upon us, nor shall we see sword nor famine;

title: Jeremiah 5:13
text: and the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

title: Jeremiah 5:14
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts: Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

title: Jeremiah 5:15
text: Behold, I bring a nation upon you from afar, house of Israel, saith Jehovah: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest thou what they say.

title: Jeremiah 5:16
text: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre; they are all mighty men.

title: Jeremiah 5:17
text: And they shall eat up thy harvest and thy bread, they shall eat up thy sons and thy daughters, they shall eat up thy flocks and thy herds, they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig-trees; they shall destroy with the sword thy strong cities, wherein thou trustedst.

title: Jeremiah 5:18
text: Nevertheless in those days, saith Jehovah, I will not make a full end with you.

title: Jeremiah 5:19
text: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah our God done all these things unto us? then shalt thou say to them, As ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

title: Jeremiah 5:20
text: ¶Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 5:21
text: Hear now this, O foolish and heartless people, who have eyes and see not; who have ears, and hear not.

title: Jeremiah 5:22
text: Will ye not fear me? saith Jehovah. Will ye not tremble at my presence, who have set the sand a bound for the sea by a perpetual decree, and it shall not pass it? and its waves toss themselves, but they do not prevail; and they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

title: Jeremiah 5:23
text: But this people hath a stubborn and a rebellious heart; they have turned aside and are gone.

title: Jeremiah 5:24
text: And they say not in their heart, Let us now fear Jehovah our God, that giveth rain, both the early and the latter, in its season; who preserveth unto us the appointed weeks of harvest.

title: Jeremiah 5:25
text: ¶Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden from you what is good.

title: Jeremiah 5:26
text: For among my people are found wicked [men]: they lay wait, as fowlers stoop down; they set a trap, they catch men.

title: Jeremiah 5:27
text: As a cage full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and have enriched themselves.

title: Jeremiah 5:28
text: They are become fat, they shine, yea, they surpass in deeds of wickedness; they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, and they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not adjudge.

title: Jeremiah 5:29
text: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 5:30
text: An appalling and horrible thing is committed in the land:

title: Jeremiah 5:31
text: the prophets prophesy falsehood, and the priests rule by their means; and my people love [to have it] so. But what will ye do in the end thereof?

title: Jeremiah 6:1
text: ¶Flee for safety, ye children of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a signal in Beth-haccerem; for evil appeareth out of the north, and a great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 6:2
text: The comely and delicate one do I cut off, the daughter of Zion.

title: Jeremiah 6:3
text: Shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch [their] tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

title: Jeremiah 6:4
text: Prepare war against her. Arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day hath declined, for the shadows of the evening are lengthening.

title: Jeremiah 6:5
text: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

title: Jeremiah 6:6
text: For thus hath Jehovah of hosts said: Hew ye down trees, and cast a mound against Jerusalem. She is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

title: Jeremiah 6:7
text: As a well poureth forth her waters, so she poureth forth her wickedness: violence and destruction are heard in her; before me continually are grief and wounds.

title: Jeremiah 6:8
text: Be thou instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from thee; lest I make thee a desolation, a land not inhabited.

title: Jeremiah 6:9
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: They shall thoroughly glean like a vine the remnant of Israel: turn back thy hand, as a grape-gatherer unto the baskets.

title: Jeremiah 6:10
text: To whom shall I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Jehovah is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

title: Jeremiah 6:11
text: And I am full of the fury of Jehovah, I am weary with holding in. Pour it out upon the children in the street, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken; the aged with him [that is] full of days.

title: Jeremiah 6:12
text: And their houses shall be turned unto others, [their] fields and wives together; for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 6:13
text: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them, every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest, every one dealeth falsely.

title: Jeremiah 6:14
text: And they have healed the breach of the daughter of my people lightly, saying, Peace, peace! when there is no peace.

title: Jeremiah 6:15
text: Are they ashamed that they have committed abomination? Nay, they are not at all ashamed, neither know they what it is to blush. Therefore they shall fall among them that fall; at the time that I visit them they shall stumble, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 6:16
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the ancient paths, which is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk [therein].

title: Jeremiah 6:17
text: Also I have set watchmen over you: --Hearken ye to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

title: Jeremiah 6:18
text: ¶Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O assembly, what is among them.

title: Jeremiah 6:19
text: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, the fruit of their thoughts; for they have not hearkened unto my words, and as to my law, they have rejected it.

title: Jeremiah 6:20
text: To what purpose should there come to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt-offerings are not acceptable, nor are your sacrifices pleasing unto me.

title: Jeremiah 6:21
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will lay stumbling-blocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall over them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 6:22
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation is stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 6:23
text: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as a man for the battle, against thee, daughter of Zion.

title: Jeremiah 6:24
text: We have heard the report thereof: our hands are grown feeble; anguish hath taken hold of us, pain as of a woman that travaileth.

title: Jeremiah 6:25
text: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for [there is] the sword of the enemy, terror is on every side.

title: Jeremiah 6:26
text: Daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and roll thyself in ashes: make mourning, [as] for an only son--bitter lamentation; for the spoiler cometh suddenly upon us.

title: Jeremiah 6:27
text: I have set thee among my people as an assayer, a fortress, that thou mayest know and try their way.

title: Jeremiah 6:28
text: They are all the most rebellious of rebels, going about with slander: they are bronze and iron; they are all corrupters.

title: Jeremiah 6:29
text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed by the fire; they have melted, and melted in vain; and the bad are not plucked away.

title: Jeremiah 6:30
text: Reprobate silver shall they call them, for Jehovah hath rejected them.

title: Jeremiah 7:1
text: ¶The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 7:2
text: Stand in the gate of Jehovah's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, all Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 7:3
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

title: Jeremiah 7:4
text: Confide ye not in words of falsehood, saying, Jehovah's temple, Jehovah's temple, Jehovah's temple is this.

title: Jeremiah 7:5
text: But if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if ye really do justice between a man and his neighbour,

title: Jeremiah 7:6
text: [if] ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed no innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt;

title: Jeremiah 7:7
text: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers from of old even for ever.

title: Jeremiah 7:8
text: Behold, ye confide in words of falsehood that cannot profit.

title: Jeremiah 7:9
text: What? steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not...

title: Jeremiah 7:10
text: then ye come and stand before me, in this house which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered, --in order to do all these abominations!

title: Jeremiah 7:11
text: Is this house, which is called by my name, a den of robbers in your eyes? Even I, behold, I have seen it, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 7:12
text: For go now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it, for the wickedness of my people Israel.

title: Jeremiah 7:13
text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith Jehovah, and I spoke unto you, rising up early and speaking, and ye heard not, and I called you, and ye answered not;

title: Jeremiah 7:14
text: I will even do unto the house which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh;

title: Jeremiah 7:15
text: and I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, all the seed of Ephraim.

title: Jeremiah 7:16
text: ¶And thou, pray not for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, and make not intercession to me; for I will not hear thee.

title: Jeremiah 7:17
text: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

title: Jeremiah 7:18
text: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink-offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

title: Jeremiah 7:19
text: Is it I whom they provoke to anger? saith Jehovah; is it not themselves, to the shame of their own face?

title: Jeremiah 7:20
text: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place; upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

title: Jeremiah 7:21
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt-offerings to your sacrifices, and eat the flesh.

title: Jeremiah 7:22
text: For I spoke not unto your fathers, nor commanded them concerning burnt-offerings and sacrifices, in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt;

title: Jeremiah 7:23
text: but I commanded them this thing, saying, Hearken unto my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people; and walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.

title: Jeremiah 7:24
text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward and not forward.

title: Jeremiah 7:25
text: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt, unto this day, have I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them;

title: Jeremiah 7:26
text: but they have not hearkened unto me, nor inclined their ear; and they have hardened their neck: they have done worse than their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 7:27
text: And thou shalt speak all these words unto them, but they will not hearken unto thee; and thou shalt call unto them, but they will not answer thee.

title: Jeremiah 7:28
text: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the nation which hath not hearkened unto the voice of Jehovah their God, nor received correction; fidelity is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

title: Jeremiah 7:29
text: ¶Cut off thy hair, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on the heights; for Jehovah hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

title: Jeremiah 7:30
text: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith Jehovah; they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

title: Jeremiah 7:31
text: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded not, neither did it come up into my mind.

title: Jeremiah 7:32
text: Therefore, behold, days are coming, saith Jehovah, when it shall no more be said, Topheth, and Valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter; for they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place.

title: Jeremiah 7:33
text: And the carcases of this people shall be food for the fowl of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall scare [them] away.

title: Jeremiah 7:34
text: And I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land shall become a waste.

title: Jeremiah 8:1
text: ¶At that time, saith Jehovah, they shall bring forth the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;

title: Jeremiah 8:2
text: and they shall spread them out to the sun and to the moon and to all the host of the heavens, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and which they have sought, and which they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the ground.

title: Jeremiah 8:3
text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, in all the places whither I have driven those that remain, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 8:4
text: ¶And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah: Do [men] fall, and not rise up? Doth one turn away, and not return?

title: Jeremiah 8:5
text: Why hath this people of Jerusalem slidden back with a perpetual backsliding? They hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

title: Jeremiah 8:6
text: I hearkened and heard: they speak not what is right; there is no man who repenteth him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? Every one turneth to his course, like a horse rushing into the battle.

title: Jeremiah 8:7
text: Even a stork in the heavens knoweth her appointed times, and the turtle-dove and the swallow and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:8
text: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of Jehovah is with us? Behold, certainly the lying pen of the scribes hath made it falsehood.

title: Jeremiah 8:9
text: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: behold, they have rejected Jehovah's word; and what wisdom is in them?

title: Jeremiah 8:10
text: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, their fields to those that shall possess [them]; for every one, from the least even unto the greatest, is given to covetousness; from the prophet even unto the priest, every one dealeth falsely.

title: Jeremiah 8:11
text: And they have healed the breach of the daughter of my people lightly, saying, Peace, peace! when there is no peace.

title: Jeremiah 8:12
text: Are they ashamed that they have committed abomination? Nay, they are not at all ashamed, and they know not how to blush. Therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall stumble, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:13
text: ¶I will utterly take them away, saith Jehovah: there are no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig-tree; and the leaf is faded: and I will give them up to those that shall pass over them.

title: Jeremiah 8:14
text: Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fenced cities, and let us be silent there: for Jehovah our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:15
text: Peace is looked for, and there is no good; a time of healing, and behold, terror.

title: Jeremiah 8:16
text: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan: the whole land trembleth at the sound of the neighing of his steeds, and they come, and devour the land, and all it contains, the city and those that dwell therein.

title: Jeremiah 8:17
text: For behold, I send among you serpents, vipers against which there is no charm, and they shall bite you, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 8:18
text: My comfort in my sadness! my heart is faint in me!

title: Jeremiah 8:19
text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people, from a very far country: Is not Jehovah in Zion? Is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, with foreign vanities?

title: Jeremiah 8:20
text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

title: Jeremiah 8:21
text: --For the breach of the daughter of my people am I crushed; I go mourning; astonishment hath taken hold of me.

title: Jeremiah 8:22
text: Is there no balm in Gilead? is there no physician there? Why then is there no dressing applied for the healing of the daughter of my people?

title: Jeremiah 9:1
text: ¶Oh that my head were waters, and mine eye a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

title: Jeremiah 9:2
text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a traveller's lodging-place, that I might leave my people, and go away from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

title: Jeremiah 9:3
text: And they bend their tongue, their bow of falsehood, and not for fidelity are they valiant in the land; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 9:4
text: Take ye heed every one of his friend, and confide not in any brother; for every brother only supplanteth, and every friend goeth about with slander.

title: Jeremiah 9:5
text: And they act deceitfully every one with his neighbour, and speak not the truth: they teach their tongue to speak falsehood, they weary themselves with perverse dealing.

title: Jeremiah 9:6
text: Thy habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 9:7
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how else could I do for the daughter of my people?

title: Jeremiah 9:8
text: Their tongue is a murderous arrow; it speaketh deceit. [A man] speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in his heart he layeth his ambush.

title: Jeremiah 9:9
text: Shall I not visit them for these [things]? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

title: Jeremiah 9:10
text: For the mountains will I take up weeping and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness, a lamentation; for they are burnt up, so that none passeth through them; and the voice of the cattle is not heard. Both the fowl of the heavens and the beasts are fled; they are gone.

title: Jeremiah 9:11
text: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling-place of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 9:12
text: ¶Who is a wise man, that he may understand this? and he to whom the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land perished, burnt up like a wilderness, so that none passeth through?

title: Jeremiah 9:13
text: And Jehovah saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not hearkened unto my voice, nor walked in it,

title: Jeremiah 9:14
text: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, as their fathers taught them;

title: Jeremiah 9:15
text: therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed this people with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink,

title: Jeremiah 9:16
text: and will scatter them among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them.

title: Jeremiah 9:17
