text: and they came into the land of Egypt: for they hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah. And they came as far as Tahpanhes.

title: Jeremiah 43:8
text: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

title: Jeremiah 43:9
text: Take great stones in thy hand, and hide them in the clay in the brick-kiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the Jews,

title: Jeremiah 43:10
text: and say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones which I have hidden, and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

title: Jeremiah 43:11
text: And he shall come and smite the land of Egypt: such as are for death to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.

title: Jeremiah 43:12
text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt, and he shall burn them, and carry them away captive; and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

title: Jeremiah 43:13
text: And he shall break the pillars of Beth-shemesh, which is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of Egypt shall he burn with fire.

title: Jeremiah 44:1
text: ¶The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who dwelt in the land of Egypt, who dwelt at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

title: Jeremiah 44:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and behold they are, this day, a waste, and no man dwelleth therein,

title: Jeremiah 44:3
text: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense to serve other gods which they knew not, they, [nor] ye, nor your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 44:4
text: And I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing which I hate!

title: Jeremiah 44:5
text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

title: Jeremiah 44:6
text: And my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are become a waste, a desolation, as at this day.

title: Jeremiah 44:7
text: And now thus saith Jehovah the God of hosts, the God of Israel: Wherefore commit ye great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, infant and suckling, out of the midst of Judah, to leave you no remnant;

title: Jeremiah 44:8
text: provoking me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye are come to sojourn, that ye should be cut off, and that ye should be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

title: Jeremiah 44:9
text: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

title: Jeremiah 44:10
text: They are not humbled unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes which I set before you and before your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 44:11
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

title: Jeremiah 44:12
text: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to enter into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed: in the land of Egypt shall they fall; they shall be consumed by the sword [and] by the famine, from the least even unto the greatest; they shall die by the sword and by the famine, and they shall be an execration, an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

title: Jeremiah 44:13
text: And I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

title: Jeremiah 44:14
text: and none of the remnant of Judah, that have come into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, so as to return into the land of Judah, whither they have a desire to return to dwell there; for none shall return but such as shall escape.

title: Jeremiah 44:15
text: ¶Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assemblage, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 44:16
text: [As for] the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of Jehovah, we will not hearken unto thee,

title: Jeremiah 44:17
text: but we will certainly do every word that is gone forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the heavens, and to pour out drink-offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and we had plenty of bread, and were well, and saw no evil.

title: Jeremiah 44:18
text: But since we left off burning incense to the queen of the heavens, and pouring out drink-offerings to her, we have wanted everything, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

title: Jeremiah 44:19
text: And when we burned incense to the queen of the heavens and poured out drink-offerings to her, did we make for her cakes to portray her, and pour out drink-offerings to her, without our husbands?

title: Jeremiah 44:20
text: ¶And Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people that had given him that answer, saying,

title: Jeremiah 44:21
text: Is it not the incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye and your fathers, your kings and your princes and the people of the land, that Jehovah remembered, and that came into his mind?

title: Jeremiah 44:22
text: And Jehovah could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, [and] because of the abominations that ye had committed; and your land is become a waste, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as at this day.

title: Jeremiah 44:23
text: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against Jehovah, and have not hearkened unto the voice of Jehovah, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil hath come upon you, as at this day.

title: Jeremiah 44:24
text: And Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt.

title: Jeremiah 44:25
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hands, saying, We will certainly perform our vows which we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the heavens, and to pour out drink-offerings unto her. Ye will certainly establish your vows, and entirely perform your vows.

title: Jeremiah 44:26
text: Therefore hear ye the word of Jehovah, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith Jehovah, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, [As] the Lord Jehovah liveth.

title: Jeremiah 44:27
text: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

title: Jeremiah 44:28
text: And they that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, a very small company; and all the remnant of Judah, that have come into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose word shall stand, mine or theirs.

title: Jeremiah 44:29
text: And this shall be the sign unto you, saith Jehovah, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall certainly stand against you for evil:

title: Jeremiah 44:30
text: thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will give Pharaoh-Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.

title: Jeremiah 45:1
text: ¶The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Nerijah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, the king of Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 45:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, concerning thee, Baruch:

title: Jeremiah 45:3
text: Thou didst say, Woe unto me! for Jehovah hath added grief to my sorrow; I am weary with my sighing, and I find no rest.

title: Jeremiah 45:4
text: Thus shalt thou say unto him, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, what I have built do I overthrow, and what I have planted I pluck up, even this whole land.

title: Jeremiah 45:5
text: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek [them] not; for behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith Jehovah; but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou shalt go.

title: Jeremiah 46:1
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

title: Jeremiah 46:2
text: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh-Necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, the king of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 46:3
text: Make ready buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

title: Jeremiah 46:4
text: Harness the horses, and mount ye horsemen, and stand forth with helmets; polish the spears, put on the coats of mail!

title: Jeremiah 46:5
text: Why do I see them dismayed, turned away back? And their mighty ones are beaten down, and take to flight, and look not back? Terror [is] on every side, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 46:6
text: Let not the swift flee away, neither let the mighty man escape! --Toward the north, hard by the river Euphrates, they have stumbled and fallen.

title: Jeremiah 46:7
text: Who is this [that] riseth up as the Nile, whose waters toss themselves like the rivers?

title: Jeremiah 46:8
text: It is Egypt that riseth up as the Nile, and [his] waters toss themselves like the rivers; and he saith, I will rise up, I will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

title: Jeremiah 46:9
text: Go up, ye horses, and drive furiously, ye chariots; and let the mighty men go forth: Cush and Phut that handle the shield, and the Ludim that handle the bow [and] bend it.

title: Jeremiah 46:10
text: For this is the day of the Lord Jehovah of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may be avenged of his adversaries; and the sword shall devour, and it shall be sated and made drunk with their blood; for the Lord Jehovah of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country, by the river Euphrates.

title: Jeremiah 46:11
text: Go up to Gilead, and fetch balm, O virgin-daughter of Egypt! In vain shalt thou multiply remedies: there is no healing for thee.

title: Jeremiah 46:12
text: ¶The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the earth; for the mighty man stumbleth against the mighty, they are both fallen together.

title: Jeremiah 46:13
text: The word that Jehovah spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, concerning the coming of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to smite the land of Egypt:

title: Jeremiah 46:14
text: Declare in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph, and in Tahpanhes; say, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword devoureth round about thee.

title: Jeremiah 46:15
text: Why are thy valiants swept away? They stood not, for Jehovah did thrust them down.

title: Jeremiah 46:16
text: He made many to stumble, yea, one fell upon another; and they said, Arise, and let us return to our own people and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.

title: Jeremiah 46:17
text: There did they cry, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath let the time appointed go by.

title: Jeremiah 46:18
text: [As] I live, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts, surely as Tabor among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.

title: Jeremiah 46:19
text: Thou, inhabitress, daughter of Egypt, furnish for thyself a captive's baggage, for Noph shall be a desolation and shall be ruined, so that none shall dwell therein.

title: Jeremiah 46:20
text: Egypt is a very fair heifer; the gad-fly cometh, it cometh from the north.

title: Jeremiah 46:21
text: Also her hired men in the midst of her are like fatted bullocks; for they also have turned back, they have fled away together, they did not stand; for the day of their calamity is come upon them, the time of their visitation.

title: Jeremiah 46:22
text: Her voice shall go like a serpent's; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

title: Jeremiah 46:23
text: They shall cut down her forest, saith Jehovah, though it be impenetrable; for they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

title: Jeremiah 46:24
text: The daughter of Egypt is put to shame; she is delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

title: Jeremiah 46:25
text: Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saith, Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, and her gods, and her kings; yea, Pharaoh and them that confide in him.

title: Jeremiah 46:26
text: And I will give them into the hand of those that seek their life, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants; but afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 46:27
text: But thou, my servant Jacob, fear not, neither be dismayed, Israel: for behold, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make [him] afraid.

title: Jeremiah 46:28
text: Fear thou not, my servant Jacob, saith Jehovah: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee, but I will not make a full end of thee; but I will correct thee with judgment, and I will not hold thee altogether guiltless.

title: Jeremiah 47:1
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh smote Gazah.

title: Jeremiah 47:2
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl,

title: Jeremiah 47:3
text: at the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his steeds, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels: fathers shall not look back for [their] children, from feebleness of hands;

title: Jeremiah 47:4
text: because of the day that cometh to lay waste all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remaineth; for Jehovah will lay waste the Philistines, the remnant of the island of Caphtor.

title: Jeremiah 47:5
text: Baldness is come upon Gazah; Ashkelon is cut off, the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

title: Jeremiah 47:6
text: Alas! sword of Jehovah, how long wilt thou not be quiet? Withdraw into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

title: Jeremiah 47:7
text: How shouldest thou be quiet? --For Jehovah hath given it a charge: against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore, there hath he appointed it.

title: Jeremiah 48:1
text: ¶Concerning Moab. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled; Kirjathaim is put to shame, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and dismayed.

title: Jeremiah 48:2
text: Moab's praise is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from [being] a nation. Thou also, O Madmen, shalt be cut down; the sword shall pursue thee.

title: Jeremiah 48:3
text: A voice of crying from Horonaim; wasting and great destruction!

title: Jeremiah 48:4
text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

title: Jeremiah 48:5
text: For by the ascent of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the descent of Horonaim is heard the anguish of the cry of destruction.

title: Jeremiah 48:6
text: Flee, save your lives, and be like a shrub in the wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 48:7
text: For because thou hast confided in thy works and in thy treasures, thou also shalt be taken, and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

title: Jeremiah 48:8
text: And the waster shall come upon every city, that not a city shall escape; and the valley shall perish, and the plateau shall be destroyed: as Jehovah hath said.

title: Jeremiah 48:9
text: Give wings unto Moab, that she may flee and get away; and the cities thereof shall become a desolation, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 48:10
text: Cursed be he that doeth the work of Jehovah negligently, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood!

title: Jeremiah 48:11
text: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and hath settled on his lees; he hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste hath remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

title: Jeremiah 48:12
text: Therefore behold, days come, saith Jehovah, that I will send unto him pourers that shall pour him off, and shall empty his vessels, and break in pieces his flagons.

title: Jeremiah 48:13
text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

title: Jeremiah 48:14
text: ¶How do ye say, We are mighty, and men of valour for the war?

title: Jeremiah 48:15
text: Moab is laid waste, and his cities are gone up [in smoke], and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 48:16
text: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

title: Jeremiah 48:17
text: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

title: Jeremiah 48:18
text: Come down from [thy] glory and sit in the drought, O inhabitress, daughter of Dibon; the spoiler of Moab is come up against thee, thy strongholds hath he destroyed.

title: Jeremiah 48:19
text: Stand by the way, and watch, inhabitress of Aroer; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth; say, What is done?

title: Jeremiah 48:20
text: Moab is put to shame; for he is broken down: howl and cry; tell it in Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

title: Jeremiah 48:21
text: And judgment is come upon the country of the plateau; upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath;

title: Jeremiah 48:22
text: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim;

title: Jeremiah 48:23
text: and upon Kirjathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon;

title: Jeremiah 48:24
text: and upon Kerijoth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.

title: Jeremiah 48:25
text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:26
text: Make him drunken, for he magnified himself against Jehovah; and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

title: Jeremiah 48:27
text: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? Was he found among thieves, that as oft as thou didst speak of him, thou didst shake the head?

title: Jeremiah 48:28
text: Leave the cities, and dwell in the rocks, ye inhabitants of Moab, and be like the dove, that maketh her nest in the sides of the cave's mouth.

title: Jeremiah 48:29
text: We have heard of the arrogance of Moab, --[he is] very proud; --his loftiness, and his arrogance, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

title: Jeremiah 48:30
text: I know his wrath, saith Jehovah; his pratings are vain: they do not as [they say].

title: Jeremiah 48:31
text: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir-heres shall there be moaning.

title: Jeremiah 48:32
text: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with more than the weeping of Jaazer: thy shoots passed over the sea, they reached to the sea of Jaazer. The spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

title: Jeremiah 48:33
text: And joy and gladness is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: they shall no more tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

title: Jeremiah 48:34
text: Because of the cry from Heshbon, unto Elaleh, unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar unto Horonaim, [unto] Eglath-shelishijah: for even the waters of Nimrim shall become desolations.

title: Jeremiah 48:35
text: And I will cause to cease in Moab, saith Jehovah, him that offereth in the high place, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

title: Jeremiah 48:36
text: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres; because the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.

title: Jeremiah 48:37
text: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped; upon all the hands are cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

title: Jeremiah 48:38
text: It is wholly lamentation upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the public places thereof; for I have broken Moab, like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:39
text: They howl, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! And Moab shall be a derision and a terror to all that are round about him.

title: Jeremiah 48:40
text: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread forth his wings over Moab.

title: Jeremiah 48:41
text: Kerijoth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and at that day the heart of the mighty men of Moab shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

title: Jeremiah 48:42
text: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:43
text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:44
text: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 48:45
text: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon powerless; for a fire hath come forth from Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and hath consumed the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the sons of tumult.

title: Jeremiah 48:46
text: Woe to thee, Moab! The people of Chemosh is undone; for thy sons are taken away in captivity, and thy daughters are captives.

title: Jeremiah 48:47
text: But I will turn the captivity of Moab at the end of the days, saith Jehovah. Thus far is the judgement of Moab.

title: Jeremiah 49:1
text: ¶Concerning the children of Ammon. Thus saith Jehovah: Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? Why is Malcam heir of Gad, and his people dwell in the cities thereof?

title: Jeremiah 49:2
text: Therefore behold, days come, saith Jehovah, that I will cause the clamour of war to be heard in Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall be a desolate heap; and her towns shall be burned with fire; and Israel shall possess them that possessed him, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:3
text: Howl, Heshbon! for Ai is laid waste; cry, daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth, lament and run to and fro within the enclosures: for Malcam shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

title: Jeremiah 49:4
text: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys? Thy valley shall flow down, O backsliding daughter, that trusteth in her treasures, [saying,] Who shall come against me?

title: Jeremiah 49:5
text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord Jehovah of hosts, from all that are about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall assemble the fugitives.

title: Jeremiah 49:6
text: And afterwards I will turn the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:7
text: ¶Concerning Edom. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Is there no more wisdom in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom spent?

title: Jeremiah 49:8
text: Flee, turn back, dwell deep down, ye inhabitants of Dedan! For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I visit him.

title: Jeremiah 49:9
text: If grape-gatherers had come to thee, would they not have left a gleaning? If thieves by night, they would destroy only till they had enough.

title: Jeremiah 49:10
text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, that he is unable to hide himself: his seed is wasted, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

title: Jeremiah 49:11
text: Leave thine orphans, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

title: Jeremiah 49:12
text: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup shall assuredly drink; and thou indeed, shouldest thou be altogether unpunished? Thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink.

title: Jeremiah 49:13
text: For I have sworn by myself, saith Jehovah, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

title: Jeremiah 49:14
text: I have heard a rumour from Jehovah, and an ambassador is sent among the nations: --Gather yourselves together, and come against her and rise up for the battle.

title: Jeremiah 49:15
text: For behold, I have made thee small among the nations, despised among men.

title: Jeremiah 49:16
text: Thy terribleness, the pride of thy heart, hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill. Though thou shouldest make thy nest high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:17
text: And Edom shall be an astonishment: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss, because of all the plagues thereof.

title: Jeremiah 49:18
text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, and their neighbour cities, saith Jehovah, no one shall dwell there, neither shall a son of man sojourn therein.

title: Jeremiah 49:19
text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will make them suddenly run away from it; and who is a chosen [man] whom I shall appoint over her? For who is like me? and who will assign me a time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

title: Jeremiah 49:20
text: Therefore hear the counsel of Jehovah, which he hath taken against Edom, and his purposes which he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: The little ones of the flock shall certainly draw them away; he shall certainly make their habitation desolate for them.

title: Jeremiah 49:21
text: The earth quaketh at the sound of their fall; there is a cry, the sound whereof is heard in the Red sea.

title: Jeremiah 49:22
text: Behold, he shall come up, and fly as an eagle, and spread forth his wings against Bozrah; and at that day the heart of the mighty men of Edom shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

title: Jeremiah 49:23
text: ¶Concerning Damascus. Hamath is put to shame, and Arpad; for they have heard evil tidings, they are melted away: there is distress on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

title: Jeremiah 49:24
text: Damascus is grown feeble: she turneth herself to flee, and terror hath seized on her; trouble and sorrows have taken hold of her as of a woman in travail.

title: Jeremiah 49:25
text: How is not the town of praise forsaken, the city of my joy!

title: Jeremiah 49:26
text: Therefore shall her young men fall in her streets, and all the men of war be cut off in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 49:27
text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-Hadad.

title: Jeremiah 49:28
text: ¶Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote. Thus saith Jehovah: Arise, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

title: Jeremiah 49:29
text: Their tents and their flocks shall they take; their curtains and all their vessels, and their camels, shall they carry away for themselves; and they shall cry unto them, Terror on every side!

title: Jeremiah 49:30
text: Flee, wander very far, dwell deep down, ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith Jehovah; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

title: Jeremiah 49:31
text: Arise, get you up against the nation at ease, that dwelleth securely, saith Jehovah, which hath neither gates nor bars: they dwell alone.

title: Jeremiah 49:32
text: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil; and I will scatter to every wind them that have the corners [of their beard] cut off, and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:33
text: And Hazor shall be a dwelling-place of jackals, a desolation for ever. No one shall dwell there, neither shall a son of man sojourn therein.

title: Jeremiah 49:34
text: ¶The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 49:35
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

title: Jeremiah 49:36
text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds, from the four ends of the heavens, and I will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

title: Jeremiah 49:37
text: And I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life; and I will bring evil upon them, my fierce anger, saith Jehovah; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them.

title: Jeremiah 49:38
text: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence king and princes, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 49:39
text: But it shall come to pass at the end of the days, I will turn the captivity of Elam, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:1
text: ¶The word that Jehovah spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, through Jeremiah the prophet.

title: Jeremiah 50:2
text: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and lift up a banner; publish, conceal not! Say, Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed: her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.

title: Jeremiah 50:3
text: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: both man and beast are fled; they are gone.

title: Jeremiah 50:4
text: In those days, and at that time, saith Jehovah, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping as they go, and shall seek Jehovah their God.

title: Jeremiah 50:5
text: They shall inquire concerning Zion, with their faces thitherward, [saying,] Come, and let us join ourselves to Jehovah, in an everlasting covenant that shall not be forgotten.

title: Jeremiah 50:6
text: My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they turned them away on the mountains: they went from mountain to hill, they forgot their resting-place.

title: Jeremiah 50:7
text: All that found them devoured them, and their adversaries said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Jehovah, the habitation of righteousness, even Jehovah, the hope of their fathers.

title: Jeremiah 50:8
text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he-goats before the flock.

title: Jeremiah 50:9
text: ¶For behold, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon, an assemblage of great nations from the north country; and they shall set themselves in array against her: from thence shall she be taken. Their arrows shall be as those of a mighty expert man: none shall return empty.

title: Jeremiah 50:10
text: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all the spoilers thereof shall be satiated, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:11
text: For ye rejoiced, for ye triumphed, ye plunderers of my heritage; for ye have been wanton as the heifer at grass, and neighed as steeds.

title: Jeremiah 50:12
text: Your mother hath been sorely put to shame; she that bore you hath been covered with reproach: behold, [she is become] hindmost of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

title: Jeremiah 50:13
text: Because of the wrath of Jehovah, it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate; every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and shall hiss, because of all her plagues.

title: Jeremiah 50:14
text: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about, all ye that bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:15
text: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand; her ramparts are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for this is the vengeance of Jehovah. Take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

title: Jeremiah 50:16
text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword let them turn every one to his people, and let them flee every one to his own land.

title: Jeremiah 50:17
text: Israel is a hunted sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria devoured him, and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

title: Jeremiah 50:18
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will visit the king of Babylon and his land, like as I have visited the king of Assyria.

title: Jeremiah 50:19
text: And I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and in Gilead.

title: Jeremiah 50:20
text: In those days, and at that time, saith Jehovah, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon those whom I leave remaining.

title: Jeremiah 50:21
text: ¶Go up against the land of double rebellion, against it, and against the inhabitants of visitation; waste and utterly destroy after them, saith Jehovah, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

title: Jeremiah 50:22
text: A sound of battle is in the land, and great destruction.

title: Jeremiah 50:23
text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! How is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

title: Jeremiah 50:24
text: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou, Babylon, art also taken, and thou wast not aware; thou art found, and also caught, for thou hast contended with Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:25
text: Jehovah hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation; for this is a work for the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, in the land of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 50:26
text: Come ye against her from every quarter, open her storehouses; pile her up like sheaves, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

title: Jeremiah 50:27
text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

title: Jeremiah 50:28
text: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Jehovah our God, the vengeance of his temple.

title: Jeremiah 50:29
text: Call together the archers against Babylon, all those that bend the bow: encamp against her round about; let there be no escaping: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath acted proudly against Jehovah, against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 50:30
text: Therefore shall her young men fall in her streets; and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 50:31
text: Behold, I am against thee, proud one, saith the Lord Jehovah of hosts; for thy day is come, the time that I visit thee:

title: Jeremiah 50:32
text: and the proud one shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up; yea, I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all that are round about him.

title: Jeremiah 50:33
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: The children of Israel and the children of Judah were together oppressed; and all that took them captives held them fast: they refused to let them go.

title: Jeremiah 50:34
text: Their Redeemer is strong; Jehovah of hosts is his name: he will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:35
text: The sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith Jehovah, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men;

title: Jeremiah 50:36
text: the sword is upon the liars, and they shall become fools; the sword is upon her mighty men, and they shall be dismayed;

title: Jeremiah 50:37
text: the sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her, and they shall become as women; the sword is upon her treasures, and they shall be robbed:

title: Jeremiah 50:38
text: a drought is upon her waters, and they shall be dried up; for it is a land of graven images, and they are mad after frightful idols.

title: Jeremiah 50:39
text: Therefore wild beasts of the desert with jackals shall dwell there, and ostriches shall dwell therein; and it shall be no more inhabited for ever, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

title: Jeremiah 50:40
text: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and their neighbour cities, saith Jehovah, no one shall dwell there, neither shall a son of man sojourn therein.

title: Jeremiah 50:41
text: Behold, a people cometh from the north, and a great nation. And many kings shall arise from the uttermost parts of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 50:42
text: They lay hold of bow and spear; they are cruel, and will not shew mercy; their voice roareth like the sea, and they ride upon horses--set in array like a man for the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 50:43
text: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands wax feeble; trouble hath taken hold of him, pangs as of a woman in travail.

title: Jeremiah 50:44
text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will make him suddenly run away from it; and who is a chosen [man] whom I may appoint over her? For who is like me? and who will assign me a time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

title: Jeremiah 50:45
text: Therefore hear the counsel of Jehovah, which he hath taken against Babylon, and his purposes which he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: The little ones of the flock shall certainly draw them away; he shall certainly make their habitation desolate for them.

title: Jeremiah 50:46
text: At the sound of the taking of Babylon the earth hath quaked, and the cry is heard among the nations.

title: Jeremiah 51:1
text: ¶Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the heart of those that rise against me, a destroying wind;

title: Jeremiah 51:2
text: and I will send unto Babylon strangers, who shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

title: Jeremiah 51:3
text: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his coat of mail; and spare not her young men: destroy utterly all her host.

title: Jeremiah 51:4
text: And the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

title: Jeremiah 51:5
text: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of Jehovah of hosts; for their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

title: Jeremiah 51:6
text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and save every man his life; be ye not cut off in her iniquity: for this is the time of Jehovah's vengeance: he shall render unto her a recompence.

title: Jeremiah 51:7
text: Babylon hath been a golden cup in Jehovah's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore have the nations become mad.

title: Jeremiah 51:8
text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and ruined. Howl over her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

title: Jeremiah 51:9
text: We have treated Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country; for her judgment reacheth unto the heavens, and is lifted up to the skies.

title: Jeremiah 51:10
text: Jehovah hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of Jehovah our God.

title: Jeremiah 51:11
text: Sharpen the arrows; take the shields. Jehovah hath stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes; for his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for this is the vengeance of Jehovah, the vengeance of his temple.

title: Jeremiah 51:12
text: Lift up a banner towards the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set the watchmen, prepare the ambushes; for Jehovah hath both devised and done that which he spoke against the inhabitants of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 51:13
text: Thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, the measure of thy rapacity.

title: Jeremiah 51:14
text: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn by himself, I will assuredly fill thee with men, as with caterpillars; and they shall raise a shout against thee.

title: Jeremiah 51:15
text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

title: Jeremiah 51:16
text: When he uttereth his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the end of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

title: Jeremiah 51:17
text: Every man is become brutish, so as to have no knowledge; every founder is put to shame by the graven image, for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

title: Jeremiah 51:18
text: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

title: Jeremiah 51:19
text: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for it is he that hath formed all things: and [Israel] is the rod of his inheritance: Jehovah of hosts is his name.

title: Jeremiah 51:20
text: Thou art my maul, [my] weapons of war: and with thee I will break in pieces the nations, and I will with thee destroy kingdoms;

title: Jeremiah 51:21
text: and with thee I will break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee I will break in pieces the chariot and its driver;

title: Jeremiah 51:22
text: and with thee will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

title: Jeremiah 51:23
text: and with thee will I break in pieces the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces governors and rulers.

title: Jeremiah 51:24
text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea, in your sight, all their evil which they have done in Zion, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:25
text: Behold, I am against thee, mount of destruction, saith Jehovah, which destroyest all the earth; and I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burning mountain.

title: Jeremiah 51:26
text: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; for thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:27
text: Lift up a banner in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare nations against her; call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the bristly caterpillars.

title: Jeremiah 51:28
text: Prepare nations against her, the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their rulers, yea, all the land of their dominion.

title: Jeremiah 51:29
text: And the land trembleth and is in pain; for the purposes of Jehovah against Babylon do stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 51:30
text: The mighty men of Babylon have ceased to fight, they are sitting in the fortresses; their might hath failed, they are become as women: they have set her dwelling places on fire; her bars are broken.

title: Jeremiah 51:31
text: Courier runneth to meet courier, and messenger to meet messenger, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city is taken from end to end;

title: Jeremiah 51:32
text: and the passages are seized, and the reedy places are burnt with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

title: Jeremiah 51:33
text: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing-floor, at the time of its being trodden; yet a little while, and the time of harvest shall come for her.

title: Jeremiah 51:34
text: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel; he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

title: Jeremiah 51:35
text: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitress of Zion say; and, My blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

title: Jeremiah 51:36
text: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her spring dry.

title: Jeremiah 51:37
text: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling-place of jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 51:38
text: They shall roar together like young lions, growl as lions' whelps.

title: Jeremiah 51:39
text: When they are heated, I will prepare their drink, and I will make them drunken, that they may exult, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:40
text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he-goats.

title: Jeremiah 51:41
text: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth seized! How is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

title: Jeremiah 51:42
text: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of its waves.

title: Jeremiah 51:43
text: Her cities are become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land wherein no one dwelleth, neither doth a son of man pass thereby.

title: Jeremiah 51:44
text: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth what he hath swallowed up; and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon is fallen.

title: Jeremiah 51:45
text: Go ye out of the midst of her, my people, and deliver every man his soul from the fierce anger of Jehovah!

title: Jeremiah 51:46
text: lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; for a rumour shall come [one] year, and after that a rumour in [another] year, and violence in the earth, ruler against ruler.

title: Jeremiah 51:47
text: Therefore behold, days are coming when I will punish the graven images of Babylon; and her whole land shall be put to shame, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

title: Jeremiah 51:48
text: And the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, shall shout aloud over Babylon; for out of the north the spoilers shall come against her, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:49
text: As Babylon caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

title: Jeremiah 51:50
text: Ye that have escaped the sword, go, stand not still: remember Jehovah from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

title: Jeremiah 51:51
text: --We are put to shame, for we have heard reproach; confusion hath covered our face: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of Jehovah's house.

title: Jeremiah 51:52
text: --Therefore behold, days come, saith Jehovah, that I will punish her graven images; and throughout her land the wounded shall groan.

title: Jeremiah 51:53
text: Though Babylon should mount up to the heavens, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith Jehovah.

title: Jeremiah 51:54
text: The sound of a cry [cometh] from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans;

title: Jeremiah 51:55
text: for Jehovah spoileth Babylon, and he will destroy out of her the great voice; and their waves roar like great waters, the noise of their voice resoundeth.

title: Jeremiah 51:56
text: For the spoiler is come against her, against Babylon, and her mighty men are taken; their bows are broken in pieces; for Jehovah, the *God of recompences, will certainly requite.

title: Jeremiah 51:57
text: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her governors, and her rulers, and her mighty men; and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.

title: Jeremiah 51:58
text: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly laid bare, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; so that the peoples will have laboured in vain, and the nations for the fire: and they shall be weary.

title: Jeremiah 51:59
text: ¶The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Nerijah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief chamberlain.

title: Jeremiah 51:60
text: And Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, all these words that are written against Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 51:61
text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, see that thou read all these words;

title: Jeremiah 51:62
text: and say, Jehovah, thou hast spoken concerning this place, that thou wilt cut it off, so that none shall dwell in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

title: Jeremiah 51:63
text: And it shall be, when thou hast ended reading this book, [that] thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates;

title: Jeremiah 51:64
text: and shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise, because of the evil that I will bring upon it: and they shall be weary. Thus far the words of Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:1
text: ¶Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

title: Jeremiah 52:2
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

title: Jeremiah 52:3
text: For, because the anger of Jehovah was against Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:4
text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, [that] Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem; and they encamped against it, and built turrets against it round about.

title: Jeremiah 52:5
text: And the city was besieged until the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

title: Jeremiah 52:6
text: In the fourth month, on the ninth of the month, the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

title: Jeremiah 52:7
text: And the city was broken into: and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden (now the Chaldeans were near the city round about); and they went the way toward the plain.

title: Jeremiah 52:8
text: And the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

title: Jeremiah 52:9
text: And they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon, unto Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he pronounced judgment upon him.

title: Jeremiah 52:10
text: And the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; and he slaughtered also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

title: Jeremiah 52:11
text: And he put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with chains of brass; and the king of Babylon carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

title: Jeremiah 52:12
text: ¶And in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, which was in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzar-adan, captain of the body-guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came unto Jerusalem;

title: Jeremiah 52:13
text: and he burned the house of Jehovah, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; and every great [man's] house he burned with fire.

title: Jeremiah 52:14
text: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the body-guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

title: Jeremiah 52:15
text: And Nebuzar-adan the captain of the body-guard carried away captive of the poorest sort of the people, and the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the deserters that had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

title: Jeremiah 52:16
text: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the body-guard left of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

title: Jeremiah 52:17
text: And the brazen pillars that were in the house of Jehovah, and the bases, and the brazen sea that was in the house of Jehovah, the Chaldeans broke up, and carried all the brass thereof to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 52:18
text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the knives, and the bowls, and the cups, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, they took away.

title: Jeremiah 52:19
text: And the basons and the censers, and the bowls, and the pots, and the candlesticks, and the cups, and the goblets, that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, the captain of the body-guard took away.

title: Jeremiah 52:20
text: The two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve brazen oxen that formed the bases, which king Solomon had made for the house of Jehovah: for the brass of all these vessels there was no weight.

title: Jeremiah 52:21
text: And as to the pillars: the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a line of twelve cubits encompassed it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

title: Jeremiah 52:22
text: And the capital upon it was brass, and the height of the one capital [was] five cubits; and the network and the pomegranates, upon the capital round about, all of brass; and similarly for the second pillar, and the pomegranates.

title: Jeremiah 52:23
text: And there were ninety-six pomegranates on the [four] sides; all the pomegranates upon the network were a hundred round about.

title: Jeremiah 52:24
text: ¶And the captain of the body-guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.
